/News/2023/Janmashtami-2023-24035.aspx.t: Shri Krishna Janmashtami Celebration, Robbinsville, NJ, USA
/News/2023/Janmashtami-2023-24035.aspx.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Janmashtami Celebration (55 photos)
 The festival of Janmashtami, marking the earthly arrival of Bhagwan Shri Krishna and, whose very existence is a fountain of inspiration, was celebrated in a program at the Festival of Inspirations in Robbinsville, New Jersey, on the evening of September 7, 2023. The Festival of Inspirations is a three-month-long festival celebrating the grand opening of the BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham in Robbinsville, New Jersey, which stands as an inspiration of ancient Hindu values in a modernized world. Each story filled with playful innocence, profound wisdom, and divine deeds shined a beacon of light on the timeless lessons from Bhagwan Shri Krishna's life. Guided by the principles he preached, the assembly embarked on a spiritual journey to embody his life teachings, which are etched in the ancient texts of Sanatan Dharma.
 Taking verses from the ancient text of the Shrimad Bhagvad Gita, the scholarly Pujya Shrutiprakash Swami expounded on the profoundly transformative power of refuge in God and how to imbibe this historical dialogue between Arjun, the disciple, and Bhagwan Shri Krishna. Through recollection of countless incidents during the Mahabharat, he shared examples of the various ways in which God had remained in the protection of devotees who had taken his refuge. He explained that when questions arise in the face of dharma (righteousness) and adharma (immoral conduct), having firm conviction in the words of God as truth is what becomes one's force of protection. 
 Renowned scholar, Mahāmahōpādhyāya Pujya Bhadreshdas Swami cited another verse from the Shrimad Bhagvad Gita - Esha Brahmi Sthiti in contemplation of how transcendence of material desires, embracing equanimity, and aligning oneself with Aksharbraman, results in the attainment of brahmi stiti, the state of utmost equilibrium and oneness with God. He explained how Bhagwan Shri Krishna's teachings on overcoming affection for worldly objects, fear and anger have provided the foundation for remaining undisturbed amidst the inevitable waves of happiness and sorrows experienced in life, noting that one cannot exist without the other. He eloquently related a reference to how the ocean remains calm on its surface despite the happenings in the deep blue sea, similarly we too must learn to attain a state of calm despite the storms within. Through the living examples of such divine beings like His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, we can learn to apply these lessons in our lives practically. 
 Drawing inspiration for the sacred text, the Vachnamrut, Sadguru Pujya Ishwarcharandas Swami illustrated the deep affection and devotion the gopis had for Bhagwan Shri Krishna. Describing the three levels of devotion the gopis exhibited towards Bhagwan Shri Krishna, he explained how Bhagwan Swaminarayan's discourse applies to one's daily life. Pujya Ishwarcharandas Swami conveyed that following even minor commands is a form of devotion similar to the gopis relinquishing their inner desires in favor of God's wish. 
 A dramatic re-enactment of the epic tale of the Mahabharat took place in the presence of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, who attentively watched the ancient story unfold. During the war between the Kauravas and the Pandavas, Arjun, a warrior and skilled archer of the Pandavas, chose the divine strength of Bhagwan Shri Krishna over strengthening his army with the might of a thousand soldiers. Having utmost faith in and with the divine power of God likened to that which Arjun and the Pandavs possessed, one will always come out victorious. 
 Following a dance depicting the stories from Bhagwan Shri Krishna's childhood, the celebration concluded with various Janmashtami traditions. His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj affectionately swung a hindolo, or decorative swing, upon which sat the murtis of a youthful Shri Krishna Bhagwan. He lovingly offered thaal, a dish of sweets, while engrossed in the divine image of God. To cap off the evening, devotional songs regaled the glory and greatness of Bhagwan Shri Krishna's compassion and unmatched devotion.   
 The birth celebrations welcomed esteemed guests to the program honoring New Jersey Assemblyman Wayne P. DeAngelo. He expressed his deep gratitude for being honored and witnessing the beautiful facility. He said, "All I can say today is thank you. Thank you for getting to witness and see the structures that I've seen here today. And thank you for the kindness of your community and the outreach that has come into our communities." Also honored were the founding member of Elysium Ventures Dr. Hari Eppanapally, and Andrew Dinsmore who works alongside U.S. Senator Chris Coons in Delaware.

/News/2023/Jivandori-Am%C4%81ri-A-Lifeli.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Puja Darshan (30 photos)
 Morning Assembly (30 photos)
 A special programme for senior devotees aged over 65 years was held in the presence of Mahant Swami Maharaj on 18 May 2023 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London.
 Vadil Din began with special bhajans performed by vadils during Swamishri’s puja in the morning, which were introduced by recordings of Yogiji Maharaj singing the opening lines. These bhajans were selected to bring back memories for the vadils who, as youths, had previously presented them to Yogiji Maharaj during his visits to East Africa and the UK in 1970. The bhajans, which were some of Yogiji Maharaj’s favourite, served as a tribute to him.
 Further memories of Yogiji Maharaj were recalled by Mahant Swami Maharaj during his morning blessings through an interactive question-and-answer session. He remembered youths cleaning the site of a disused church in Islington, which was converted into the first BAPS mandir in the Western hemisphere. Swamishri, who was also present at the time, interacted with the audience through personal gestures that brought those cherished memories to life.
 Anandswarupdas Swami addressed the attendees later in the morning to provide guidance on the next stage of their spiritual journey. He emphasised the importance of continuing their spiritual activities with enthusiasm and offering their time in seva.
 These messages were reinforced by Sadguru Tyagvallabhdas Swami, who explained how vadils can continue to engage in devotion without distractions. He also reflected upon the ‘jivandori’ (spiritual lifeline for an aspirant seeking ultimate liberation) that has been attained and encouraged the gathering to reflect upon this during their daily activities.
 A ‘Jivit Kriya’ mahapuja was held in the presence of Shri Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj. The essence of this collective prayer was to seek blessings for the senior devotees as they reflect upon their spiritual lives and further detach themselves from worldly attractions in order to more fully devout themselves to God. The mahapuja also provided an opportunity to pray for peace and prosperity across the world.

/News/2023/Jivishu-Swamine-Mate---Yuva-S.t: 'Jivishu Swamine Mate' - Yuva Shibir 2023, Atladara (Vadodara), India
/News/2023/Jivishu-Swamine-Mate---Yuva-S.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Yuva Shibir (67 photos)
 More than 1,150 yuvaks and yuvatis of Vadodara attended the Yuva Shibir held at the BAPS Mandir in Gadhada in the presence of Pujya Viveksagar Swami. Themed ‘Jivishu Swāmine Māte...’ (We Will Live for Swami…), the shibir guided the youths on how to practice Satsang in their daily lives and to strengthen their bond with the Satpurush.
 On the first day, the youths visited the holy places in Gadhada sanctified by Bhagwan Swaminarayan – Gopinath Dev Mandir, Dada Khachar's Darbar, Akshar Ordi, Lakshmi Vadi – and Jiva Khachar’s Darbar and the exhibition ‘Gadhpur Jota Shriji Sambhare’ at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir.
 During the shibir, six main topics were discussed: 1. Shikshan (Education); 2. Satsang: Daily Puja, Yuva Sabha, Satsang Reading; 3. Saiyam (Restraint): Stri-Purush Maryada, Social Media Consciousness, Dietary Discretion; 4. Samjan (Understanding), 5. Seva: Physical and Spreading Satsang; and 6. Satpurushma Jodan (Attachment with the Satpurush): Prapti (Attainment), Smruti (Remembrance), Observing Spiritual Commands. A new theme song was composed for the shibir that incorporated these topics.
 Guruhari Mahant Swami Maharaj himself wrote beautiful motivational sentences on these six topics. Each topic was elaborated upon through speeches, workshops, case studies, skits, discussions, seminars, videos and other activities.
 The in-person speakers included Pujya Viveksagar Swami, Atmatrupt Swami, Adarshjivan Swami and Bhaktisagar Swami, while Pujya Dr. Swami, Pujya Bhaktipriya (Kothari) Swami and Pujya Tyagavallabh Swami inspired the youths via video conference.
 On the night of 12 May, swamis from Sarangpur presented a melodious kirtan aradhana.
 On 14 May, after completion of the shibir, all the youths had darshan at Sarangpur Mandir, Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir, Pramukh Swami Maharaj Smruti Mandir and other sacred places before returning to Vadodara.

/News/2023/Keshav-Kavya-Kalarav-Poetry-C.t: ‘Keshav Kavya Kalarav’ Poetry Convention, BAPS Swaminarayan Research Institute, New Delhi, India
/News/2023/Keshav-Kavya-Kalarav-Poetry-C.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Poetry Convention (26 photos)
 A grand poetry convention titled, ‘Keshav Kavya Kalarav’, was organized by BAPS Swaminarayan Research Instutite, Akshardham, New Delhi.
 Original poems, muktaks and ghazals in Hindi, Sanskrit and English on the subjects of 'Guru', 'Bhagwan', 'Atmavichar', 'Sankhya Vichar', 'Akshaya Anand'  were submitted from which the selection committee invited the creators of the best creations to present their creations at the function.
 This special program started with the lighting of the lamp and an address by Munivatsaldas Swami, in which he described poetry as an integral part of devotion. Then, a Sanskrit poem by Mahamahopadhyay Bhadresh Swami, Head of the BAPS Swaminarayan Research Institute, who was not present, was recited.
 Thereafter, 22 participants, aged between 19 and 90 years, presented their poems on Guru-Glory, Guru-Love, God's Blessings, Guru Education, Beauty of Akshardham, Guru Darshan, Guru Kripa, Virtues of God and Guru and other topics.
 Among the contributors were Dr. Yuvraj Bhattaraiji, recipient of the 2019 Sahitya Academic Yuva Puraskar, who narrated his composition dedicated to Maa Kali; and former High Court Chief Justice and present Lokpal Abhilasha Kumariji, who presented a wonderful composition on Guru Mahima.
 The recitations by the participants filled the atmosphere with divine joy.
 At the end, the winners were presented awards on behalf of the BAPS Swaminarayan Research Institute, Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi.

Photo Gallery 
 Swamishri’s Puja (40 photos)
 Morning Session (20 photos)
 Evening Programme (80 photos)
 During his stay in Nenpur, over an ten-day period in 2020, Mahant Swami Maharaj composed a letter about ‘prapti-no kef’ (the intense joy of spiritual attainment). This letter formed the basis of the Sanyukta Din held in the presence of Mahant Swami Maharaj on Sunday 21 May 2023 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London.
 Senior devotees began the day by singing kirtans related to various aspects of this theme in Swamishri’s puja. Young children also recited verses linked to specific aspects from that letter. In his morning blessings, Swamishri provided detailed guidance on how one can better realise the glory of this prapti through faith and divyabhav.
 Sadguru Tyagvallabhdas Swami, Anandswarupdas Swami and Santcharitdas Swami further elaborated on the concept of prapti in a later morning session by drawing upon examples of ideal devotion from Swamishri’s life. Tyagvallabhdas Swami then led the thal-gaan offering to Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj.
 The Sanyukta Din continued with an evening assembly which began with a deeper analysis of extracts from Mahant Swami Maharaj’s letter. The spiritual significance of various themes from this letter formed the basis of a panel discussion and discourses from swamis and senior volunteers.
 Mahant Swami Maharaj was joyously welcomed to the programme with a vibrant dance. Following his arrival, the audience was taken on an eye-opening journey of a devotee named Yogesh, as he navigated through life’s trials and tribulations – conveyed through a captivating drama.
 The drama charted three important junctures of Yogesh’s life – the first, when he arrived at a crossroads during his early youth period; thereafter, when he faced the challenges of a dilemma in prioritising his spiritual and family life; and finally, in the latter years of his life, where the enjoyment of spiritual bliss waned as he experienced the comforts of retirement.
 At each juncture, esteemed and pious devotees from the past provided solace by accompanying Yogesh to the ‘Sahajanandi Darbar’, where Mahant Swami Maharaj was seated, and away from ‘Jagatno Bhandar’, a life of worldly pleasures and pitfalls. Swamishri was integrated into the drama and duly interacted with Yogesh, providing spiritual guidance and vigour. His transformation was supported by kirtans and narrations of excerpts from the Vachanamrut describing the greatness of God.
 Swamishri’s actions and words throughout the evening created personal memories for thousands who witnessed the programme live at the Mandir and many more who were watching the online webcast. 
 An emotional and heartfelt prayer was offered to Mahant Swami Maharaj on behalf of all devotees. Swamishri waved a flag to affirm that true spiritual realisation will be achieved. He then blessed the assembly and provided concluding guidance, leaving all with a profound understanding of prapti and charging them with the conviction to strengthening their spiritual bond with God.

/News/2023/Kids-Diwali-Celebrations-2023.text:
Diwali, a significant Hindu festival, symbolizes the return of Bhagwan Shri Ram to Ayodhya, embodying values such as love, compassion, courage, and unity. Recognizing its importance, BAPS organized Kids’ Diwali Celebrations at various mandirs across North America. The theme for this year's celebration was "Strength in Unity." Through diverse programs and engaging skits, children learned about unity, discipline, and the impact of their daily choices on achieving success and happiness.
 The event featured a special Diwali Showcase, where stories from Hinduism were narrated, emphasizing how its values can be integrated into everyday life. Interactive games, moon bounces, and other activities were part of the celebrations. The event also included Saraswati Pujan, honoring the Hindu goddess of knowledge, arts, and wisdom.
 These experiences left the children with a deeper appreciation and understanding of Hinduism and the essence of Diwali. Under the guidance of Mahant Swami Maharaj, the current guru of BAPS, these celebrations in North America continue to foster spiritual knowledge and growth among children.

/News/2023/Kishore-Kishori-Din-23965.asp.t: Kishore - Kishori Din | Swami Malavathi, Robbinsville, NJ, USA
/News/2023/Kishore-Kishori-Din-23965.asp.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Kishore-Kishori Din - Part 1 (27 photos)
 Kishore-Kishori Din - Part 2 (94 photos)
 Kishore-Kishori Din Virtual Participation (36 photos)
 Strengthening bonds is a means to deeply know a person. At the two-part program, “Swami Malvathi - A Journey of Smrutis” on August 19, 2023, North American youth shared heartfelt reflections on how every gesture, blessing, and memory of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj forged their firm bond with their beloved guru. A relationship with a guru is among the most transformative relationships in life. A guru serves as a friend, a mentor, and most importantly, a guide through life's ups and downs. Part 1 of the program began in the afternoon with a special set of perspectives from women. They highlighted their personal experiences, demonstrating how distance is no obstacle to forming a spiritual connection with the guru. These recollections depicted emotional, intimate, and unique connections with Mahant Swami Maharaj, as they navigated challenges and successes in their personal, educational, and family lives. Through reflections on prayer, service, devotion, and memories from his previous spiritual tours in North America, many conveyed how Mahant Swami Maharaj profoundly influenced countless devotees.
 Part 2 of the program, which took place in the evening in the presence of Mahant Swami Maharaj, continued this theme. Throughout the evening, youths candidly shared their experiences of college life and living away from home, reflecting on the intuitive foresight and support they received from Mahant Swami Maharaj's correspondence. Having witnessed the unconditional selfless love Mahant Swami Maharaj showered upon thousands through highly personalized letters, Pujya Gurumanandas Swami elaborated on these messages. By seeing God in every individual and possessing compassion and care for all, while never prioritizing himself, Mahant Swami Maharaj fulfills the inner desires of everyone who places their deepest troubles at his feet.
 Several honored guests shared remarks that resonated with the day’s themes. Robbinsville Township Council President Deborah Blakely advised, “Our journey is to discover what you are passionate about, what brings you joy and fulfillment. Use these insights on your journey, whether in your community, school, or place of worship. This world is yours; you represent the future.” Dr. Basu-Ray observed, “We can employ the world's latest technologies to attempt to save someone’s life, but modern medicine doesn't heal the mind. Every moment should be a spiritual one, thanking God and our guru for our place in life.” AAHOA Chairman Bharat Patel remarked, “Many of us know our family, but we are uncertain about our faith. This is not just a monument to our faith but also to our family, culture, and heritage. Passing this on to the next generation is crucial.” Dr. Gaurav Shah recalled the transformative impact of his time with Pramukh Swami Maharaj, noting, “The world looked different after a week with Pramukh Swami Maharaj. It's like I saw the world with clarity. That’s the power of the presence of the divine person like Pramukh Swami Maharaj.” Mr. H. R. Shah conveyed lessons from Pramukh Swami Maharaj, emphasizing the importance of family for the younger generation. Dr. Chirag Patel galvanized the audience, sharing, “The world can look beautiful if you are spiritual. What you are doing here and what is passed to our generations to come is unthinkable and only can be done with the grace of Bhagwan Swaminarayan, Pramukh Swami Maharaj, and Mahant Swami Maharaj.”
 The program showcased the pivotal role the guru plays in navigating transformative years, nurturing youth in every aspect of their lives and empowering them for the future. Mahant Swami Maharaj provided practical guidance for a successful life, advising teens to engage in daily spiritual practices to solidify their foundation, while being mindful of the youthful challenges of social media, distractions, and negative influences. Addressing concerns about staying connected, Mahant Swami Maharaj assured the youth that when their inner desires align with his, their bond remains unbreakable.
 In his loving blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj stated, “The happiness and sorrows of this world will come and go for all, but if you keep your focus on prapti, then happiness and sorrows will not affect you. Remember, prapti is infinitely greater than your problems, you have nothing left to worry about since you have Maharaj and Swami. You obtained the unattainable. Our fortune knows no bounds.” The program concluded with an absolutely memorable evening, as a youthful Mahant Swami Maharaj matched the energy of the teenagers on stage joining them in the jubilant celebration. Through gestures of affection, Mahant Swami reminded the excited youths that memories together don’t disappear in the absence of one another.
 This program was part of the Festival of Inspirations in Robbinsville, New Jersey. Lasting three months, the festival celebrates values to inspire future generations through the newly-built BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham in Robbinsville, New Jersey, aiming to foster values within individuals for self-improvement and harmony.
 The program honored distinguished guests who journeyed to witness the Akshardham campus. Guests included:
 Padmashri Dr. H.R. Shah, Chairman and CEO of TV Asia
 Bharat Patel, Chairman, Asian American Hotel Owners’ Association (AAHOA)
 Rahul Patel, AAHOA Secretary
 Dr. Gaurav Shah, CEO of Rocket Pharmaceuticals
 Alpesh Patel, Secretary, Leuva Patel Samaj of USA
 Dipak Patel, Vice Chair at Dunkin Donuts and wife Varsha Patel with Anna Management
 Vinay Patel, Principal, Head of External Affairs at Sree Hotel, and wife Shefali Patel
 Dr. Indranill Basu, Cardiologist & Interventional Electrophysiologist
 Ram Javia, Member of local Hindu Organizations in Maryland
 Falguni Shah, Singer and Grammy winner
 Chirag Patel, Amneal Pharmaceuticals Co-Founder and President, along with his wife Priti Patel
 Christine Cuoco, Manager and Leader of Ruby Memorial Services
 Deborah Blakely, Robbinsville Township Council President and integral member of the Mercer County Special Services

/News/2023/Kishore-Kishori-Shibirs-2023-.t: Kishore-Kishori Shibirs 2023: Kah Pantha? Path of Happiness, Africa
/News/2023/Kishore-Kishori-Shibirs-2023-.text:
Over 1115 kishores and kishoris attended the Kishore-Kishori National Conventions held at four major BAPS centers in Africa: Nairobi, Kenya; Dar-es-Salaam, Tanzania; Mayfair, South Africa; and Kampala, Uganda.
 Themed ‘Kah Pantha? Path of Happiness’, the conventions delved into the profound concept that faith in God constitutes the genuine path to lasting happiness, transcending the fleeting allure of materialistic pursuits.
 During the conventions, attendees were guided through introspective sessions and workshops that explored how remembrance (smruti), prayer (prarthana), and observance of God’s commands (agna) increase one’s faith in God, ultimately leading to eternal happiness. Based on true examples and practical tips, the delegates were inspired to undertake daily devotional activities to strengthen their own faith in God and guru: arti, nitya puja, mansi puja, satsang reading, chesta, and being honest with the guru.
 The conventions also addressed the pitfalls on the path to happiness. Engaging discussions dissected the impact of screens, social media, and the internet on personal well-being and spiritual growth, urging attendees to recalibrate their relationship with these digital interfaces.
 The conventions answered the question, ‘Kah Pantha?’ (Which Path?): ‘Mahajano yena gatah sa pantha’ – Follow the path taken by the great. The resounding message was clear to all attendees: while temporary pleasures may captivate one momentarily, it is faith in God that paves an enduring road to genuine and lasting happiness. The conventions illuminated the minds of the teenagers with the wisdom that can lead them toward a fulfilled and spiritually enriching life.

/News/2023/Kishore-Kishori-Shibirs-2023-.t: Kishore-Kishori Shibirs 2023: Pacific Rangvu Chhe: Akshar-Purushottam ni Bhakti thi Rangvu Chhe, Asia Pacific
/News/2023/Kishore-Kishori-Shibirs-2023-.text:
Over 400 youngsters attended the one-day Kishore-Kishori Shibirs held at 12 major BAPS centers across Australia and New Zealand, based on the theme, ‘Pacific Rangvu Chhe: Akshar Purushottam ni Bhakti thi Rangvu Chhe’.
 Each shibir was thoughtfully organized into three illuminating sessions. The first session, discussed the Akshar-Purushottam Upasana, presenting a comprehensive understanding of the theological and philosophical underpinnings of BAPS.
 In the second session, the attendees explored the concept of Akshar-Purushottam bhakti through introspection, discussions and contemplation on three profound quotes, and presenting their interpretations in the form of 60-second skits. This was followed by enlightening speeches by swamis and a panel discussion on the significance and transformative impact of daily satsang reading in the lives of youths.
 The third session featured a compelling skit that underscored the paramount importance of observing niyams and addressed the pervasive influence of social media in today's world. Speeches by swamis further elucidated the necessity of niyams, both in the worldly context and within satsang. The session culminated with a constructive discussion on the effects of social media, providing practical solutions for managing its impact in a positive and balanced manner.
 The Kishore-Kishori Shibirs helped to empower the attendees to embrace and fortify their spiritual foundations to enhance their journey of self-discovery, spiritual growth, and service to the community.

/News/2023/Leader-of-the-Opposition-Sir-.t: Leader of the Opposition Sir Keir Starmer Celebrates Diwali at Neasden Temple, London, UK
/News/2023/Leader-of-the-Opposition-Sir-.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Sir Keir Starmer at Neasden Temple (12 photos)
 The Rt Hon Sir Keir Starmer MP, Leader of the Opposition and the Labour Party in the UK, visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London – popularly known as Neasden Temple – on Monday 13 November 2023 to celebrate the festival of Diwali.
 The visit underscored Sir Keir’s commitment to engaging with diverse communities and celebrating cultural events that enrich the fabric of British society.
 Sir Keir was welcomed with traditional marks of goodwill by senior swamis and trustees of the Mandir.
 During his time at the Mandir, Sir Keir immersed himself in the Diwali festivities, joining in ceremonial prayers and experiencing the warmth of the community spirit. He also engaged with young and senior volunteers of the Temple and learned of its various contributions to the community.
 After arriving in the assembly hall, Sir Keir addressed the congregation. He said: “I stand in awe of the celebrations here and the selfless seva of thousands of volunteers – working with such care and commitment to make this iconic occasion a reality. Their extraordinary efforts do not go unnoticed. A temple of this scale and perfection and the spirit of limitless sacrifice and dedication that animates it does not come about by chance. Neasden Temple is a beacon of compassion and harmony for everyone – regardless of creed or background – [and is] an integral part of the religious and cultural landscape of Great Britain.
 “To British Indians, I want to express my admiration and respect for everything you do for our country. Quite simply, the UK would be diminished in so many ways without you.”
 Dr Mayank Shah, a trustee and volunteer at the Mandir, added, “We were honoured to have Sir Keir Starmer with us at Neasden Temple today during such an auspicious time of the year. We appreciate the time he took out to join the local community of British Hindus in celebrating and reinforcing key Hindu values such as family respect, civic duty, and public service – values which are also quintessentially British values.”
 Sir Keir departed the assembly after receiving a special gift representing fulfilment and auspiciousness.

 Life-Enhancing Seminars by Dr Gnanvatsaldas Swami (32 photos)
 Dr Gnanvatsaldas Swami, a learned BAPS swami and a highly sought-after motivational speaker, delivered a series of insightful seminars during his visit to the UK and Europe in October 2023.
 The presentations were held at BAPS mandirs and external venues in London (Harrow, Brent and Ilford) and Leicester in the UK as well as in Interlaken, Switzerland.
 Gnanvatsaldas Swami spoke on topics such as ‘Positivity in Adversity’, ‘Stress Management’, ‘The Secret of Success: Unity’, ‘Reinvent Evolve Lead’, and ‘My Family, Happy Family’.
 The topics allowed attendees to receive practical guidance on how to tackle contemporary challenges currently being faced by individuals and families in both their personal lives as well as their professional careers.
 One delegate, working in finance, shared her experience after attending one of the seminars in London. She said, “What a refreshing and relatable talk! It was wonderful to gain an insight into the inspiring leadership of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and Mahant Swami Maharaj. These are values that are important for any organisation and its people, and I look forward to using their lives as inspiration for my own organisation for the future.”

/News/2023/Magnificent-Mahayagna-for-Wor.t: Magnificent Mahayagna for World Peace, Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi, India
/News/2023/Magnificent-Mahayagna-for-Wor.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Mahayagna for World Peace (19 photos)
 Around 1,700 devotees participated in the Vishwa Shanti Mahayagna at Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi, to pray for world peace on the auspicious occasion of Vijaya Dashami (Dussehra).
 Devotees sat in groups around the 111 specially prepared yagna kunds. Accompanied by the chanting of holy mantras, devotees performed the Vedic rituals and made the traditional offerings into the yagna kunds. In addition, recital of the 315 verses of the Satsang Diksha shastra added to the spiritual atmosphere.
 After completion of the mahayagna, Bhaktavatsal Swami addressed the spiritual assembly, “As per the Upanishads, yagna is a special ceremony of devotion and prayers. Today, when the world is facing challenges and difficulties, we turn to God to bless us on this auspicious day with the wisdom to create and spread peace and harmony. Let us all endevour to work towards ‘Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam’ (The world is one family), because Pramukh Swami Maharaj always said, ‘In the joy of others lies our own.’”

/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharaj-90th-Jan.t: Mahant Swami Maharaj 90th Janma Jayanti Mahotsav, Robbinsville, NJ, USA
/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharaj-90th-Jan.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Mahant Swami Maharaj 90th Janma Jayanti Mahotsav (89 photos)
 In an emotional jubilation, filled with dances and excitement, thousands of devotees from across North America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, India, and Australia joined the 90th birth anniversary of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj with a program themed “Celebrating Spiritual Legacy” in Robbinsville, New Jersey on October 7, 2023. The theme highlighted the love and humility that Mahant Swami Maharaj embodies with every breath, expounding on the virtues of service, saintliness and divinity.
 Compassionate humanitarianism as lived by Mahant Swami Maharaj for decades was showcased through his life messages and unmatched virtues. Through the course of nine decades, he has practiced, promoted, and instilled the spirit of selfless service in thousands across the globe. During the COVID-19 pandemic, one of the most devastating times of the 21st century, Mahant Swami Maharaj appealed with a compassionate message that the value of saving one life is priceless, and responded to the global suffering by launching numerous relief efforts and awareness campaigns. Similarly, at the beginning of the war in Ukraine, he made a call to action for volunteers to encourage all to help understand the value of saving one life is priceless. In those moments, however, these volunteers drew inspiration from Mahant Swami Maharaj and his steadfastness, along with his resolve that acts of service have no borders.
 Alongside the virtue of service, Mahant Swami Maharaj has been the epitome of saintliness for ninety years. Sadguru Pujya Ishwarcharandas Swami shared his experiences of this godly virtue in his guru. He described how over the decades traveling with Mahant Swami, there had not been one instance in which he failed to exhibit dasatvabhav (serving the divine in all), nirmanipanu (humility), and sevakbhav (desire to help others). Continuing this sentiment, Pujya Brahmaviharidas Swami captured that today is a celebration of saintliness at its peak because he has given a new dimension and depth to its meaning. Through his pure love, the language and light of Mahant Swami Maharaj’s saintliness is that he forgives, gives and believes in us.
 The story of Mahant Swami Maharaj’s life is also a celebration of ninety years of divinity. Pujya Anandswarupdas Swami, speaking on his personified form of humility, explained that a person's greatness lies in the fact of how virtuous he is. His life is God-centric, living according to the commands of God, never in transgression. Mahant Swami Maharaj’s divinity shined even brighter after the passing of his guru, when he said “God is the all-doer; we are merely the instrument and hands of God, and this is a legacy which has been left to us by Pramukh Swami Maharaj.” Having spiritually grown alongside Mahant Swami Maharaj, Pujya Swayamprakashdas Swami (Doctor Swami) recalled his divinity and desire to join the path of renunciation from his youth. Despite being the leader of such a large organization, he has exemplified how no act of service is too small.
 On a day meant to celebrate the extraordinary life of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, he instead took the occasion to write and share his innermost feelings on the inauguration of Swaminarayan Akshardham. “To all of Pramukh Swami’s beloved devotees and all the volunteers of Akshardham, you all have done seva without looking at your own comforts. I stand witness to this, how much you all have sacrificed. It pains me deeply that I will not be able to meet you all during the inauguration of Akshardham. I will perform the ceremony remembering each of you. You all are my hands and feet, and I am grateful to all of you. Due to the immense seva of 12,500 volunteers, this consecration will happen tomorrow. Wherever you are, please believe that Maharaj (God) is sitting across from you and I will remember all of you dearly tomorrow.”
 Joining in the celebration, the assembly was privileged to hear from several respected guests.
 Swami Paramatanandaji, founder of Acharya of Arsha Vidya Mandir - “I have had the fortune to meet [Mahant Swami Maharaj] almost 48 years ago. All these years, one thing I observed is that he is nothing but the embodiment of Hindu culture, values and dharma.”
 Wesley Matthews, President and CEO of Choose New Jersey, attended on behalf of the Governor of New Jersey and First Lady recalling a motto from his own faith “If there is an ethos in my 10 years of knowing the BAPS community, it is that this community is lightened to enlighten the community that they are in. You have done that in such a beautiful way here.”
 Jack Hawley, Barnard College Claire Tow Professor of Religion and Columbia University - “To see this (Akshardham) being constructed around us is a miracle for those of us with the eyes to see, and I would say there is something, at least for me, very special about being here on this day, the day before the great event itself."
 Jack Ciattarelli, Former New Jersey Assemblyman District 16 - “This magnificent cultural center will be a beacon for the practice of Hinduism. It is often said that New Jersey is the most diverse state in the country, indeed it is. There is power and beauty in that diversity when we embrace it. This magnificent cultural center and this magnificent place of worship for Hinduism will help us to be better in terms of that diversity.”
 The program concluded with the presentation of two proclamations marking Akshardham Day in New York. Heartfelt moments unfolded as all the senior swamis presented Mahant Swami Maharaj with beautiful garlands and decorative shawls on behalf of all devotees for the occasion of his birth celebration. Keeping in the spirit of Mahant Swami Maharaj’s love and compassion for all, he then led the assembly in prayers for the recent conflict in the Middle East.
 The nine-day inaugural ceremonies, known as Akshardham Mahotsav, will conclude with the inauguration ceremony and grand celebration of Swaminarayan Akshardham on the evening of October 8, 2023.

/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharaj-Joyously.t: Mahant Swami Maharaj Joyously Welcomed at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London, UK & Europe
/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharaj-Joyously.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Mahant Swami Maharaj’s Arrival at London (40 photos)
 Mahant Swami Maharaj was joyously welcomed to the UK and Europe by thousands of devotees and well-wishers on Tuesday 2 May 2023 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London.
 Streams of people filled the Mandir steadily from 3.30am, eagerly awaiting their first darshan of him in London since 2017. Live updates of Mahant Swami Maharaj’s journey to the Mandir from the airport were relayed, which included photographs and a personal voice note from Swamishri shortly after he landed at Luton Airport, in which he said: “I am just as eager to have your darshan as you are to be with me.”
 Youths sang welcoming kirtans in the morning assembly, which were interspersed with discourses from swamis who narrated inspiring accounts of Mahant Swami Maharaj’s spiritual greatness and his selfless compassion. A series of video clips of Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s previous visits to the UK were also shared as the anticipation of Mahant Swami Maharaj’s arrival continued to build.
 Swamishri arrived on Pramukh Swami Road shortly after 6.30am, where he was greeted with flags and a showering of flower petals from devotees and volunteers who had lined the street. The vibrant welcome continued inside the courtyard of the Mandir, where youths offered their own devotional reception with dancing while swamis greeted him at the Mandir steps. Youths on the steps held aloft a large sign with Swamishri’s handwriting in which he had written in 2020, during the Mandir’s 25th anniversary, “London Mandir Our Home.”
 Swamishri continued inside the Mandir and performed abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni Maharaj, then proceeded for darshan of the murtis before finally making his way to the assembly hall.
 A few weeks prior to his arrival, Mahant Swami Maharaj was asked how devotees can best prepare for his visit to the UK. He guided everyone towards internal improvement – specifically, on increasing divyabhav (seeing the divinity in everyone) and personal purity through antardrashti (introspection). This led to ‘The Divyabhav Project’ and ‘The Antardrashti Project’ in which children, youths and families engaged in a number of ways to imbibe these principles and make personal life improvements.
 Personal pledges from these projects were transcribed into four types of origami (artistically folded paper) shapes – clams, butterflies, swans, and lotuses – which depicted promises to perceive virtues in others, transformation from seeing divinity in others, humility and service, and remaining pure amidst impurities. More than 5,500 of these patiently hand-folded decorative pieces flanked Mahant Swami Maharaj’s path from the moment he had entered the Mandir.
 Mahant Swami Maharaj arrived inside the main hall amid scenes of ecstatic joy and overwhelming happiness. Many from the thousands who had gathered from the early hours of the morning could not hold back their tears of joy, whilst others danced and some simply folded their hands in prayer and reverence.
 The welcome continued with offerings of garlands made from various objects, including further pledges written on origami shapes. Many devotees across the UK and Europe had also undertaken special austerities as a devotional form of welcome for Mahant Swami Maharaj. These efforts were recognised and appreciated by Swamishri before he briefly addressed the devotees to conclude the assembly.
 Dipa Patel, who had travelled more than 200 miles from Preston, shared her experience: “When I first saw him enter the hall, I had goosebumps! I was filled with joy and peace. We’ve waited six years for him to be with us here in the UK again, and the next five weeks will bring so many opportunities for my family, my children and me to strengthen our connection with him and progress on our spiritual journey together.”
 All the latest news and updates about Mahant Swami Maharaj’s stay at Neasden Temple (London Mandir), including live webcasts, will be available from msm.neasdentemple.org.

/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharaj-Leads-Co.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Coronation Tribute to HM King Charles III (20 photos)
 His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj led the tributes to commemorate the historic Coronation of His Majesty King Charles III and Her Majesty Queen Camilla on Saturday 6 May 2023 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London.
 As the country celebrated the momentous occasion throughout the day, the Mandir was also honoured that the Chair of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha UK, Jitu Patel, was invited to join other senior faith leaders to greet HM The King at the coronation ceremony in Westminster Abbey with a joint message of goodwill.
 During the evening assembly, Yogvivekdas Swami, Head Swami of London Mandir, shared his message of congratulations for Their Majesties while Kamlesh Patel, a senior BAPS volunteer, reflected upon the warm, friendly relationship that His Majesty has enjoyed with BAPS for over four decades, as well as his personal affection and admiration for His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj. 
 Mahant Swami Maharaj had written a personal letter to His Majesty King Charles III, in which he extended his warmest congratulations on behalf of the global BAPS Swaminarayan fellowship. This letter was read by Paramtattvadas Swami before Mahant Swami Maharaj lighted a traditional lamp as a symbol of auspiciousness and prosperity while young children chanted the Shanti Path – an ancient Vedic prayer – as the whole congregation prayed for peace and harmony to prevail across the world.
 In conclusion, Mahant Swami Maharaj addressed the assembly, saying: “Your Majesty, on behalf of everyone at BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha around the world, I send you my heartiest congratulations. 
 “We pray to God that you remain in good health and can serve the people of this country with righteousness and moral fortitude. May our friendship continue to blossom. We look forward to welcoming you not only here at Neasden Temple, but to our temples across the world. 
 “Our heartfelt wishes for the success and happiness of you, the Royal Family, and all the people of the United Kingdom.”

/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharajs-90th-Bi.t: Mahant Swami Maharaj's 90th Birthday Celebration, Robbinsville, NJ, USA
/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharajs-90th-Bi.text:
24:10
 Mahant Swami Maharaj's 90th Birthday Celebration
 10:33
 Letters of Inspiration
 Photo Gallery 
 Mahant Swami Maharaj's 90th Birthday Celebration (76 photos)
 "Yours Forever, Sadhu Keshavjivandas": these words have completed hundreds of thousands of letters written by His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj to people around the world. Inked in these letters are his compassion, love, and respect for all. On September 13, 2023, hundreds of devotees gathered to celebrate the 90th birthday of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj in his divine presence in Robbinsville, New Jersey. The celebrations centered around his humility and love, showcasing how Mahant Swami Maharaj touched the lives of millions across the globe through the letters he wrote.
 This year, the celebrations were integrated into the Festival of Inspirations, a three-month-long celebration of the upcoming inauguration of BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham in Robbinsville, New Jersey.
 Mahant Swami Maharaj penned words of compassion and care to innumerable devotees, but his words also provided strength and motivation when written for collective action toward spiritual growth. Pujya Yogananddas Swami highlighted the power of Mahant Swami's statements, the intention of every word he wrote being only for the spiritual and personal progress of countless devotees. By seeing these excerpts, one bears witness to how sincerely Mahant Swami Maharaj has spent a lifetime encouraging the transmission of gnan, or spiritual knowledge, through recitation of scriptural verses and inspiring hundreds of youth to engage in seva, or selfless service, gaining priceless and transformative life lessons.
 Devotees of varying backgrounds and ages recollected personal stories of how letters from Mahant Swami Maharaj carried them through life's joys and sorrows with faith, resilience, and steadfastness of mind as a spiritual guide, friend, and mentor. Oftentimes, little did they know how attentively Mahant Swami Maharaj tended to each letter, frequently even reading the same letter multiple times to understand the complexity and intricacies of its content before responding. This purity and enhanced spirituality earned Mahant Swami Maharaj a place in the hearts of many.
 In heartfelt videos, world leaders, devotees, and spiritual leaders from across the globe shared their impressions of meeting His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj. They impressed upon the audience Mahant Swami Maharaj's aura of compassion, spirituality, and peacefulness. In the words of Cyrus Sabavala, "He doesn't say a word, but his face and impression are so powerful, so divine, that you surrender your whole life to him. The divinity that radiates from Mahant Swami Maharaj transcends words - one simple look or gesture is enough to fill one's heart with love."
 Mahant Swami Maharaj's utmost humility shines through during one particular incident from 2001. Before a convention, Mahant Swami Maharaj spent hours preparing what he thought was an engaging presentation for youth traveling from the US to India. As the children began falling asleep during the presentation, Mahant Swami Maharaj did not utter a word of disappointment or rebuke. Instead, he later apologized to the children, citing his mistakes that he felt caused their disinterest and discomfort. Despite their young age, Mahant Swami Maharaj viewed the children as divine; he is a paradigm of reflection, always keeping the ideal of humility at the forefront of his life.
 Pujya Anandswarupdas Swami highlighted Mahant Swami Maharaj's enduring humility and servitude. Citing instances where Mahant Swami Maharaj saw the best in others, he emphasized his role as das na das, serving others despite his divine stature. Although his spiritual magnificence is boundless, he views himself as a servant, spotting virtues where others see flaws. He has uplifted numerous devotees through his letters, instilling humility in them.
 To have spent decades alongside brothers, grow into their leader, yet still maintain the utmost respect and quiet service amongst them is the epitome of Mahant Swami Maharaj's humble character. In a touching exchange, on a day he should be celebrated, Mahant Swami Maharaj instead shined a light of inspiration on the senior swamis in attendance, giving credence to why thousands love him. Sharing the exemplary virtues of each individual senior swami, Mahant Swami defined the inspiration he gained from the lives of selfless service from Sadguru Pujya Swayamprakashdas Swami (Doctor Swami), Sadguru Pujya Bhaktipriyadas Swami (Kothari Swami), Sadguru Pujya Tyagvallabhdas Swami and Sadguru Pujya Ishwarcharandas Swami. In turn, they recited their innermost prayers for Mahant Swami Maharaj on his 90th birthday celebration, and each senior swami lovingly presented Mahant Swami Maharaj with individual garlands.
 Concluding the celebratory program, Mahant Swami Maharaj's blessings drew upon the wonder and simplicity of what has been accomplished through vision and dedication. "The creation of BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham in Robbinsville was the divine resolution of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Whoever comes here to Akshardham will experience its splendor, divinity, and peace. By spending fifteen minutes daily reflecting on what we have attained spiritually, everything is captured within this."

Photo Gallery 
 Padyatra (78 photos)
 More than 1,800 devotees of all ages joined the special 9 km padyatras organized by 14 BAPS centers to mark the 90th birthday of guruhari Mahant Swami Maharaj and express their devotion and reverence towards him. The distance of 9 kilometres symbolized Mahant Swami Maharaj’s birth on Bhadarva vad 9.
 The participants were provided selected prasangs and teachings of Mahant Swami Maharaj to read and reflect upon while walking. They also engaged in group discussions and contemplation on these prasangs, and engaged in gun-grahan and singing dhun. The walks were characterized by a profound atmosphere of spirituality and devotion. After the padyatras, participants engaged in darshan, pradakshina and arti at the designated destination.

/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharajs-Grand-A.t: HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's Grand Arrival in Toronto Sparks Joy among Devotees, Toronto, ON, Canada
/News/2023/Mahant-Swami-Maharajs-Grand-A.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Preparations (20 photos)
 Swagat (55 photos)
 In the early morning of Friday, June 9, 2023, His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj graced North America with his presence, receiving a jubilant welcome from thousands of devotees and well-wishers at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Toronto, Canada. As the evening of June 8th melted into the early hours of June 9th, a continuous stream of people filled the mandir, eagerly anticipating their first darshan of Mahant Swami Maharaj in Toronto since 2017. The devotees had come dressed in festive attire, reminiscent of Diwali and to symbolize that the Guru's presence is the light in our lives. With mounting excitement,  Swamis took the opportunity to share motivational and inspiring messages, guiding everyone on how to fully embrace the blessings brought by Mahant Swami Maharaj's visit to Toronto.
 At 1:45 am, Mahant Swami Maharaj arrived at the mandir, where he was warmly welcomed with flowers, sparklers, and a grand garland. His car came to a stop in front of the mandir, where he admired the beautifully arranged lights adorning the entrance and steps. The enthusiastic reception continued inside the mandir, where he witnessed a captivating glow-in-the-dark dance performance by youth. He also met approximately 50 Swamis and several volunteers before entering the assembly hall. 
 In the assembly hall, thousands of people warmly greeted Mahant Swami Maharaj. Once on stage, Swamis delivered brief speeches expressing the joy felt by Bhagwan Swaminarayan, Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagatji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj, and Pramukh Swami Maharaj at the presence of Mahant Swami Maharaj in Toronto. When asked about his own happiness to be in Toronto, Mahant Swami Maharaj responded by joyfully spreading his arms.
 Next, Mahant Swami Maharaj blessed the devotees who had observed various fasts in anticipation of his arrival. He expressed his heartfelt recognition and appreciation for their efforts and the hard work of the volunteers who had prepared for his arrival. He then briefly addressed the devotees to conclude the assembly.
 The arrival of Mahant Swami Maharaj in Canada and the warm reception by the devotees created an atmosphere of unity, devotion, and celebration, marking a significant milestone in the spiritual journey of the community.

/News/2023/Mahant-Swamin%C4%81-Rangm%C4%.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Rangotsav (60 photos)
 A month of lifelong memories with Mahant Swami Maharaj in London culminated in a final celebration of colourful, spiritual bliss on Wednesday 7 June 2023 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London.
 Bhagwan Swaminarayan blessed the village of Sarangpur in Gujarat, India, by celebrating the rangotsav (festival of colours) on many occasions – a tradition that Mahant Swami Maharaj continues today.
 The festival is renowned for providing defining memories, which thousands of devotees celebrated during a memorable evening in the presence of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj and Mahant Swami Maharaj.
 The evening assembly was held in the courtyard of the Mandir and began with themed kirtans describing the historical significance of the rangotsav festival from the time of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Swamis interspersed these with discourses that delved deeper into the traditions of this festival and spoke of the profound devotional experiences of swamis and devotees.
 Thereafter, Mahant Swami Maharaj was joyously welcomed to the festivities. He also drew upon the devotional vibrancy of rangotsav during his blessings, recalling, in particular, the iconic celebrations in the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He urged everyone to immerse themselves in this special occasion.
 After ritually welcoming Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj to the festival, Swamishri sprayed the maha-murti of Pramukh Swami Maharaj with sanctified, saffron-scented water, which was reciprocated towards him. Memorably, both Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s maha-murti and Swamishri’s chair rotated on turntables so that they faced each other during the arti and rangotsav celebrations.
 Devotees were then showered with pure joy and selfless love as Swamishri sprayed them with sanctified coloured water, imprinting everyone with cherished and enduring experiences of divinity.

/News/2023/Mahima-Din---Inspiring-Positi.t: Satpurush in Canada | Mahima Din, Toronto, ON, Canada
/News/2023/Mahima-Din---Inspiring-Positi.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Mahima Din (51 photos)
 On June 17, 2023, the Mahima Din celebration, attended by HH Mahant Swami Maharaj, marked a significant event for BAPS volunteers. This day was rich with spiritual discussions, skits, and inspiring stories that underlined the importance of maintaining a positive mindset.
 The celebration began with engaging skits performed by dedicated BAPS volunteers. Crafted to inspire positivity and offer practical strategies for fostering such thinking, these skits allowed volunteers to showcase their creativity and talent while conveying powerful messages that resonated with the audience.
 Subsequent to the skits, senior BAPS Swamis imparted guidance on sustaining positive mindsets. Their wisdom and teachings added depth to the event, underscoring the need to cultivate positive thoughts in all life facets.
 Throughout the celebration, attendees were treated to various stories illustrating HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's immense appreciation for the volunteers and devotees. These tales served as testimonials to the volunteers' dedication, commitment, and altruism in serving their communities.
 Esteemed guests graced the Mahima Din event, recognizing and lauding the substantial contributions BAPS volunteers make to society. These guests included:
 The Hon. Ahmed Hussen, Minister of Housing, Diversity, and Inclusion, Supt. Mandeep Mann, Toronto Police Service, Inspector Jack Gurr, Toronto Police Service, Sergeant JK Gill, Waterloo Regional Police, Constable Jash Manani, Gulf Police Service, Constable Leslie Smith, Peel Regional Police.
 These distinguished guests extolled BAPS's community service, acknowledging the volunteers' relentless efforts and unwavering commitment to positively impacting society. The Hon. Ahmed Hussen presented BAPS with a Certificate of Acknowledgment on behalf of the Federal Government of Canada, further accentuating the significance and reach of BAPS's volunteer initiatives.
 The Mahima Din celebration proved to be a resounding success, leaving an indelible mark on all attendees. The event effectively highlighted the power of positive thinking and the incredible work done by BAPS volunteers through captivating skits, insightful discourses, and inspiring stories. The presence and commendation of notable guests further underscored the organization's community service. Mahima Din served as a testament to the transformative power of committed volunteers and the cultivation of positive mindsets.

/News/2023/Mare-Banvu-Chhe-Upasak-Karyak.t: Mare Banvu Chhe Upasak Karyakar | Karyakar Din, UK & Europe
/News/2023/Mare-Banvu-Chhe-Upasak-Karyak.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Puja Darshan (20 photos)
 Karyakar Din (60 photos)
 A special day for volunteers, titled ‘Mare Banvu Chhe Upasak Karyakar’, was held in the presence of Mahant Swami Maharaj on Sunday 14 May 2023 at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan, London. The theme was inspired from a letter previously written by Mahant Swami Maharaj encouraging karyakars to strengthen the spiritual understanding that guides and drives their seva.
 The event consisted of skits, panel discussions and motivational speeches, as well as an interactive session with Mahant Swami Maharaj, whose vision of the ideal volunteer in the service of others provided valuable guidance to delegates from across the UK and Europe.
 Volunteers from various departments began the day by singing themed bhajans during Swamishri’s puja which were introduced with heartfelt pledges to draw upon the lives of the Guru Parampara and reflect their values of selfless service and courage in their own respective seva roles.
 Swamishri was formally welcomed to the event by karyakars from across the country and presented with a decorative invitation for the evening. Addressing the delegates, he explained that a true karyakar always seeks to improve and develop, and perceives virtues in others, thus serving all others with utmost humility.
 Sadguru Tyagvallabhdas Swami and Anandswarupdas Swami provided further insight during a morning session with responses to searching questions from karyakars. Their discourses offered practical as well as spiritual guidance on how karyakars can serve with greater impact by drawing upon the ideal examples of the Guru Parampara.
 During the evening programme, a panel of swamis and karyakars shared inspiring testimonies of volunteers from across the UK and Europe who have served with enthusiasm, dedication and conviction despite facing physical hardships. This remarkable service has led to a steady growth of satsang activities across Europe.
 Mahant Swami Maharaj was welcomed to the assembly with a devotional offering of flowers from karyakars. Following his arrival, Swamishri interacted with the audience during a series of short sketches that explored relevant areas of focus for karyakars, including taking ownership and the spirit of unity and togetherness. Swamishri offered his guidance during these performances.
 His personal contribution continued through a light-hearted game show that revealed important messages for karyakars. He explained that ego is the gravest obstacle in performing seva effectively and that remembering God as the all-doer is the most important thought that karyakars should imbibe in their duties.
 Swamishri concluded the programme by reciting a special prayer, charging karyakars with renewed energy and motivation. The delegates thanked Swamishri by offering their personal mark of devotion and reverence at the conclusion of the event.

/News/2023/Maru-Kartavya--National-Karya.t: Maru Kartavya | National Karyakar Shibir, Germany
/News/2023/Maru-Kartavya--National-Karya.text:
Photo Gallery 
 National Karyakar Shibir, Germany (36 photos)
 BAPS satsang has been growing steadily in Germany over recent years, with six major centres currently established across the country. This has led to a call from local volunteers for further guidance.
 Thus, from 25 to 27 August 2023, a three-day shibir for over 160 karyakars was arranged in the presence of swamis from BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London, amid the picturesque settings of the European Youth Education Centre in Weimar, central Germany.
 The shibir was inaugurated with video blessings from Mahant Swami Maharaj, in which he had personally scribed the shibir’s theme, ‘Maru Kartavya’, underscoring the profound sense of duty and commitment of a BAPS karyakar.
 Overall, the conference explored how one can perform one’s seva (service) with passion, humility, and integrity. Enlightening sessions featured a series of insightful talks by swamis and senior volunteers as well as a history of satsang activities across Europe.
 In-person presentations as well as live video presentations by swamis from the UK and India delved into the responsibilities of a volunteer, focusing on the virtues and principles to help them excel in their personal spiritual development as well as their social and professional lives.
 Breakout sessions allowed the delegates to share inspiring stories of other volunteers as well as best practices from across various centres.
 Team-building activities, free time during meals, and a night-time tour of the historic city of Weimar helped the delegates to further enjoy each other’s company and build closer friendships, while a vibrant kirtan bhakti programme infused the event further with devotional fervour.
 Many karyakars were deeply motivated and rejuvenated by the shibir, describing it as “a much-needed recharge” and “a home-away-from-home experience in the presence of swamis and the BAPS family.” The palpable samp (unity) among the delegates left a lasting impression, inspiring them to continue their dedicated service in Germany with renewed vigour and devotion.

/News/2023/Mayor-of-London-Visits-Neasde.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Mayor of London Visits Neasden Temple (16 photos)
 The Mayor of London, Sadiq Khan, visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London (popularly known as ‘Neasden Temple’), on Sunday 21 May 2023.
 The Mayor was welcomed by Yogvivekdas Swami, head swami for BAPS in the UK and Europe, as well as trustees of the Temple. 
 The highlight of the Mayor’s visit was a personal meeting with His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj. This exchange involved fruitful discussions during which the Mayor thanked His Holiness for the contributions made by Neasden Temple and asked for his blessings.
 Addressing the evening assembly, the Mayor said: “I am here to show my respects to His Holiness, but to also ask for his blessings on the capital city of our great country.
 “His Holiness and I met earlier, and I was explaining the massive contribution you [Neasden Temple and its congregation] make to our City – whether it is in business, public service or charity. I explained to His Holiness that the ripples of good you do are felt by everybody – Hindus, Muslims, Sikhs, Jews, Christians, Buddhists, those members of an organised faith and those that aren’t.
 “Please continue to be an example to the teachings of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj. Please continue to be a source of inspiration. We’ve had an awful two or three years because of the [Covid-19] pandemic and during those dark times, you and your community were the light. Me and my family, you and your family, our city, our country needs the teachings and the blessings of His Holiness.”
 Before departing, the Mayor added, “I came here to ask for his [His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj’s] blessings. I hope the next time he comes isn’t so far away and he comes again, and again and again – sooner rather than later.”
 Dr Mayank Shah, a trustee at the Mandir, also shared: “We extend our gratitude to the Mayor for his visit to our Temple, his generous words and his enriching exchange with His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj.”

 Medico-Spiritual Conference (24 photos)
 Over 400 yuvaks and yuvatis studying medicine, dentistry, Ayurveda, homeopathy and physiotherapy participated in the annual Medico-Spiritual Students Conference. To be eligible for the conference, each delegate had to pass written tests based on two designated books: Sadhutana Shikhar Mahant Swami Maharaj and Satsang Diksha.
 This year’s conference theme was ‘Nishthavan Bhava – Develop Firm Faith’. The students were guided on developing firm faith in siddhant (principles), dharma (duties), kartrutva (responsibilities), seva and guru through speeches by Jnaneshwar Swami, Atmatrupt Swami, Adarshjivan Swami, and other learned and experienced swamis.
 The attendees also participated in workshops, discussions, quizzes and other activities.

 Bharatnatyam Showcase (12 photos)
 On Friday, June 30, 2023, the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Robbinsville, NJ, hosted – the Melodies of Motion - Bharatnatyam Showcase. The traditional performance gave members of the local community an opportunity to witness India’s vibrant culture through Bharatnatyam, a form of Indian classical dance.
 Over thirty young women of all ages performed various Bharatnatyam dances under the open sky. Originally performed as a highly revered act of devotion, dancers expressed their spirituality using intricate footwork, expressive hand gestures (mudras), and captivating facial expressions.
 The event honored a long history of Bharatnatyam dancers and highlighted their contributions to Indian art and culture.
 Neha Patel, a renowned Bharatnatyam instructor at Nritya Traditions shared, “Watching the women perform devotional dances at a place where art, culture, and spirituality converge was sublime.”

/News/2023/Murti-Pratishtha-Ceremony---P.t: Murti Pratishtha Ceremony - Part 2, Robbinsville, NJ, USA
/News/2023/Murti-Pratishtha-Ceremony---P.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Murti Pratistha Ceremony - Part 2 (197 photos)
 On October 4, 2023, a momentous event took place at the BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham in Robbinsville, NJ, as the second of three sessions of the Murti Pratishtha ceremony was presided over by His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj. This sacred ceremony marked the consecration of divine murtis, including Bhagwan Shri Ram, Sitaji, Hanumanji, Lakshmanji; Bhagwan Shri Shiv, Parvatiji, Ganeshji, Kartikeyaji; Bhagwan Shri Krishna, Radhaji; Bhagwan Shri Tirupati Balaji, Padmavatiji and the revered lineage of BAPS spiritual gurus.
 Prior to the commencement of the Vedic rituals, Pujya Ishwarcharandas Swami spoke on the trials and tribulations that Shastriji Maharaj, the founder of BAPS, faced when establishing the Akshar-Purushottam principle. Detailing the challenges and lack of resources during that era of satsang, he contrasted against being days away from the opening of the BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham in North America. He emphasized how far the faith and sacrifices of our gurus have brought us to this moment. He expressed gratitude and grace to Bhagwan Swaminarayan, whose sacred image will take a central place inside Akshardham, forever benefiting many generations of people who will visit.
 The auspicious occasion witnessed the presence of distinguished guests, with Pujya Swami Govinddev Giri, Treasurer of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, among the honored attendees. Addressing the assembly, he said, " That you’ve forever constructed (BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham) is a lighthouse. What is a temple? It is a lighthouse, and it shall give its light forever. This lighthouse will spread through generations in the form of knowledge. This is a temple of humanity; a temple of faith; a temple of universal love; a temple of universal brotherhood.” This significant ceremony exemplifies the deep spiritual and cultural significance of the BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham in North America and its commitment to preserving and promoting Hindu heritage.
 In his blessings, His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj said that all who visit this Akshardham will be inspired by the messages carved in the stone. Swamishri guided all that now it’s time for us to take inspiration from the physical landmark and build Akshardham within ourselves, filling it with devotion, purity, and humility. Noting the extraordinary nature of everyone’s dedication, Mahant Swami Maharaj offered deepest gratitude to all who played a role in Akshardham’s completion.
 Throughout the nine-day inaugural ceremonies, Akshardham Mahotsav will celebrate the significant aspects of the mahamandir and the universal values upon which it was constructed.

/News/2023/Murti-Pratishtha-Ceremony-Swa.t: Murti Pratishtha Ceremony Swaminarayan Akshardham Mahamandir, Robbinsville, NJ, USA
/News/2023/Murti-Pratishtha-Ceremony-Swa.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Murti Pratishtha Ceremony (179 photos)
 After a decades-long wait for this joyous moment, the consecration ceremony for the central sanctum of BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham took place on the morning of October 8, 2023. This final ceremony installing the sacred divine image of Bhagwan Swaminarayan to take a permanent home on this now holy land in Robbinsville, New Jersey was much anticipated by thousands across the world.
 Nearly three decades ago, His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj had expressed a divine wish to build the Akshardham Mahamandir in North America. He had blessed the project over the years from India and made a historic journey to sanctify the land during his final spiritual tour in 2014, at the age of 93. In a land purifying ceremony, Pramukh Swami placed a sanctified pot within the ground at the exact location where the murti of Bhagwan Swaminarayan would be installed today, nine years later by His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj.
 On this morning’s occasion, Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami reminded everyone of the letter His Holiness penned and read Saturday night to all the volunteers who selflessly served in the making of Swaminarayan Akshardham. Such sincere and love-filled words filled the letter from a humble guru, promising that he will remember the thousands across the globe during the aarti of this momentous ceremony. Mahant Swami Maharaj reiterated over the past couple of days the sentiment that it is our great fortune to have this indescribable landmark here in America, however, there is more significance in instilling the values represented by Akshardham within our hearts and lives.
 Swaminarayan Akshardham represents the abode of Bhagwan Swaminarayan, preserves Hindu values, and aims to inspire all to live an elevated approach to life.
 Pujya Swayamprakashdas Swami (Doctor Swami) emphasized the immeasurable value of Swaminarayan Akshardham. Giving the example of how kings of the past built grand monuments with their infinite wealth, he drew the paradox that the wealth of building Akshardham was spiritual in nature. In America, 12,500 volunteers came to immerse themselves in difficult seva (selfless service), perfectly, for two years; this was a labor of love and service. Their firm conviction in Swaminarayan Bhagwan is so ingrained into every stone of Akshardham, that all who come to Akshardham will see their faith in this mahamandir. Doctor Swami explained that though we have built Akshardham, the main message is to become like God’s ideal devotee Gunatitanand Swami who has taught us how to become an ideal devotee ourselves.
 This sacred ceremony to awaken the life within the murti of Bhagwan Swaminarayan is a deeply spiritual tradition. By immersing his eyes, heart, mind and soul into the sacred image of God before him, Mahant Swami Maharaj attentively and lovingly carried out the various components of the ritual, according to ancient scriptures and tradition. Simultaneously, Pujya Ishwarcharandas Swami performed the ceremony for the murti of God’s divine devotee, Gunatitanand Swami. The ceremony included invocation mantras and blessing different parts of the murtis, which signify bringing to life God’s compassionate use of his being for the benefit of his devotees. This ceremony is not merely symbolic, as it also awakens the divinity we see and feel within God’s murti.
 Prior to his arrival, Mahant Swami Maharaj wrote another letter on this occasion. In his blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj read the letter to those present and watching virtually recounting a prarthna he wrote. He recalled the inner wish Pramukh Swami Maharaj held for decades that now has come to fruition. Even through the hardships, to see this Akshardham brings inner happiness. He said the same Bhagwan Swaminarayan along with his Aksharbhram present in God’s abode is the same present here. He spoke on the importance of unity saying it’s the foundation of any unit and prays that it grows across the world.  He spoke on the divinity of this Akshardham experience and prayed for peace and happiness to all.
 Today’s ultimate display of devotion to one’s guru coincides with the equally auspicious occasion of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj’s birth anniversary falling in the Hindu calendar. As such, the senior swamis offered beautiful flower garlands to Mahant Swami Maharaj on behalf of the devotees spread across not only the North American continent but across the globe.

Photo Gallery 
 Murti-Pratishtha Mahotsav (26 photos)
 A two-day celebration marked the inauguration of the new BAPS Mandir in Sotik, Kenya, in the presence of Priyavrat Swami and other swamis.
 Previously, in Surat, on 4 May 2022, Mahant Swami Maharaj had performed the Vedic murti-pratishtha rituals of the murtis.
 As requested by Pujya Bhaktipriya (Kothari) Swami, this mandir has been built within the residence of Shri Kantibhai Patel and his sons, Ashwinbhai, Mukeshbhai, Maineshbhai, and Pareshbhai. Within the house an assembly hall was constructed wherein the murtis were ceremoniously installed.
 The first day featured a kirtan aradhana by swamis and devotees. On the second day, the murtis were honoured in a grand procession, after which the mahapuja and murti installation rituals were performed.  A magnificent annakut was also offered to the murtis. Sadguru swamis blessed the assembly via video. Then Priyavrat Swami addressed the devotees and well-wishers and urged them to take advantage of daily satsang and devotion through the mandir.

 Shobha Yatra (23 photos)
 Kirtan Aradhna (16 photos)
 Murti Pratistha (54 photos)
 Murti Pujan & Abhishek by Mahant Swami Maharaj (6 photos)
 The chanting of Vedic verses and the singing of the arti filled the air with excitement and anticipation for the murti pratishtha of Shri Nilkanth Varni Maharaj at the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Detroit, located in Canton, MI. Devotees gathered with joy on August 27th, 2023 to welcome Shri Nilkanth Varni Maharaj by participating in a mahapuja. The murti pratishtha ceremony was followed by a stage program comprising of blessings from Sadguru Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami, as well as other swamis, and a folkdance performance.
 Leading up to the event was a seven-day parayan, which commenced on Sunday, August 20th, filled with spiritual discourses delivered by Pujya Gnanvatsaldas Swami, Pujya Yogendradas Swami and Sadguru Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami.
 As part of the festivities, Mahila Din took place on August 26, featuring performances and engaging spiritual content. The program, hosted by the women’s wing of BAPS, was centered on the theme, “Meri Yatra Kalyan Ke Liye Hai” and highlighted the purpose of Nilkanth Varni’s travels across India at the age of 11. The journey encompassed many perils and tribulations; and Nilkanth Varni persevered, to bestow liberation to all whom he encountered.
 As the day of August 26 progressed, the air of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir Detroit, was filled with devotional music and folkdances, as devotees gathered around Nilkanth Varni Maharaj’s murti in a procession that toured the murti in form of a Shobha Yatra around the mandir campus.
 Ending the day was a musical program consisting of devotees from across the country who gathered to offer their devotion through singing and playing traditional instruments and religious melodies. The kirtan aradhana encapsulated the joy of the devotees leading up to the Mahotsav. All were swaying in their seats and enthusiastically singing and clapping in accompaniment to the wonderful sounds.
 Guruhari Mahant Swami Maharaj had consecrated the murti of Shri Nilkanth Varni Maharaj in Toronto on July 7, 2023. This week-long celebration was a final welcoming at his new home.

 The historic murti sthapan cermony of the new murtis at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Syracuse, NY took place on Saturday, November 4, 2023, amidst Vedic chanting and devotional festivities. The ceremony, led by Pujya Yagnavallabhdas Swami and Pujya Gnanpriyadas Swami, began with a Vedic Mahapuja, followed by the sacred murti-sthapan vidhi. The ceremony concluded with the placement of the divine murtis of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagwan Shri Krishna, Shri Radhaji;  Bhagwan Shri Ram, Shri Sitaji, Shri Hanumanji; Bhagwan Shri Shiv, Shri Parvatiji, Shri Ganeshji and the murtis of BAPS Gurus - Brahmaswarup Bhagatji Maharaj, Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj, Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj, Brahmaswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj, Pragat Brahmaswarup Mahant Swami Maharaj.
 These murtis were earlier consecrated by His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj on July 28, 2023, in Robbinsville, NJ. The mandir itself was inaugurated previously on October 9, 2006. Following the ceremony, an annakut, comprising various vegetarian items, was offered to the newly consecrated murtis. The attendees were filled with joy and a sense of spiritual fulfillment as they witnessed the murti-sthapan vidhi, a ceremony that marks a significant milestone in the life of the mandir and its community.
