/News/2025/Diwali-at-State-Capitols2025-.t: Diwali at State Capitols: Celebrating Light, Service, and Community, North America
/News/2025/Diwali-at-State-Capitols2025-.text:
Diwali, the Festival of Lights, is celebrated worldwide by Hindus, Jains, Sikhs, and some Buddhists. In the United States, it has become a cherished moment of cultural celebration, uniting diverse communities in honoring the triumph of light over darkness, knowledge over ignorance, and good over evil.
 For years, BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha has hosted Diwali celebrations at state capitols across the country, bringing together elected officials and community leaders. In 2025, these gatherings continued that tradition, offering an opportunity to reflect on the universal values that Diwali represents — unity, hope, and service.
 Through the lighting of traditional diyas (ceremonial lamps), inspiring remarks, and vibrant cultural presentations, Diwali at state capitols served as a powerful reminder that light and harmony can bring people together across backgrounds and beliefs.
 As the glow of diyas illuminated state capitols, officials and citizens alike gathered in a shared celebration of cultural richness and civic unity. The Diwali celebrations at the state capitols stood as a testament to how ancient traditions continue to inspire community, compassion, and collective upliftment in today’s world.

Photo Gallery 
 Education and Careers Fair, UK (60 photos)
 More than 1,200 delegates from around the UK, including students, parents and young professionals, attended an Education and Careers Fair at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London – popularly known as ‘Neasden Temple’ – on Saturday 1 February 2025.
 The event provided attendees with invaluable guidance, practical training, and vital confidence for academic success and career development through tailored workshops, expert panels, and networking opportunities.
 The day commenced with an inaugural lamp-lighting ceremony by Yogvivekdas Swami (Head Swami of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha in the UK and Europe), symbolising the spread of knowledge worldwide.
 Workshops focused on exam techniques, career planning, and professional branding, with dedicated sessions on CV writing, job applications, and networking strategies.
 Attendees also benefited from one-on-one career consultations and getting high-quality headshots for their LinkedIn profile.
 A keynote session featured Hinal Patel and Ghanshyam Ramparia – two senior BAPS volunteers – who shared their personal journeys of balancing professional success with spiritual growth, inspired by His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj and His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj.
 Sonia Morar, an associate partner at KPMG, also delivered an inspiring talk on female empowerment, emphasising resilience, mentorship, and overcoming workplace barriers.
 Recognising the role of parents in education, the fair also delivered specialised discussions where experienced parents and swamis shared insights on supporting children in their academic and spiritual journeys. Volunteers also presented information on degree apprenticeships as an alternative career path.
 The afternoon featured a diverse careers fair representing over 35 industries, including aviation, engineering, finance, healthcare, IT, law, and marketing. Professionals offered first-hand insights, while recruiters provided CV reviews, interview preparation tips, and assessment centre guidance.
 The event proved to be highly successful, with many attendees sharing their positive impressions of the day. One university student said, “I had paid money to go to a fair like this! But this one at the Mandir was far more helpful. I gained so much clarity and confidence on what I want to do in my future,” while a mother added, “Excellent! Really helpful for both students and parents. I can’t thank you enough for doing so much for our children – more than we [parents] could ever do ourselves.”
 The event concluded with renewed motivation and confidence among the participants, reinforcing BAPS’s commitment to youths and their academic, professional, and spiritual development.

/News/2025/First-Anniversary-Celebration.t: First Anniversary Celebration of BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi, UAE
/News/2025/First-Anniversary-Celebration.text:
Photo Gallery 
 First Anniversary Celebration of BAPS Hindu Mandir (34 photos)
 The BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi marked its first anniversary with a grand celebration and also commemorated The Year of Community – A year of unity, service, and faith – in the presence of UAE leadership, community leaders and devotees. As the patron of this event, His Excellency Sheikh Nahayan Mabarak Al Nahayan, Minister of Tolerance, travelled directly from Portugal for this special occasion. He was joined by His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Hamad bin Tahnoon Al Nahyan, Advisor for Special Affairs at the Presidential Court, along with 450 dignitaries, ambassadors, community and faith leaders. Additionally, over 20 members from the royal family, ministers, and UAE leadership were present.
 On this special day, the Mandir welcomed 11,000 visitors in addition to over 2,000 who gathered for the special occasion, bringing the total attendance to more than 13,000 people.
 Comprising six distinct segments, the program, titled ‘Mandir: The Heart of Community’, commenced in the presence of His Excellency Sanjay Sudhir, Ambassador of India to the UAE, His Excellency Dr. Mugheer Khamis Al Khaili, Chairman of the Department of Community Development, His Excellency General Ahmed Saif bin Zaitoon Al Muhairi, Commander-in-Chief of Abu Dhabi Police, and other prominent UAE dignitaries.
 Following a year-in-review video, highlighting the Mandir's remarkable achievements over the past year, His Excellency Sheikh Nahayan Mabarak Al Nahayan addressed the gathering. He emphasized the profound impact and significance of the Mandir in fostering unity, harmony, cultural understanding and bilateral relationships. He spoke about the Mandir’s role as a beacon of faith and service, stating, “This is a handsome Mandir that is bringing the community together.”
 In the first section, Global Community, His Excellency Sanjay Sudhir, who had travelled directly from Delhi to attend, highlighted the mandir's significance in India-UAE relations, stating, “This is the most tangible form of India and UAE friendship, one that you can feel.”
 The Interfaith Harmony segment featured Mufaddal Ali, a prominent businessman from the Bohra Muslim community in the UAE, who shared how the Mandir’s spirit of inclusivity inspired him to donate The Harmony Wall, the largest 3D-printed wall in the region and how it continues to foster unity across diverse communities.
 In the Community Values segment, Zubin Karkaria reflected on how effortlessly the Mandir instills values in the community, specifically highlighting how it has helped to nurture timeless values and character in his children.
 The Inner Strength segment was led by rising tennis star Hursh Patel, who spoke about how the Mandir has been a source of resilience in his journey, providing him with mental clarity, focus, and perseverance through its serene atmosphere and spiritual wisdom.
 In the Faith segment, Umesh Raja, Head of Guest Services at the BAPS Hindu Mandir and a former international schools inspector, spoke about how the Mandir has become a sanctuary that strengthens faith – not only for devotees but for thousands of visitors who leave feeling spiritually enriched and uplifted.
 In the final segment, Inner Happiness, Brahmaviharidas Swami began by expressing heartfelt gratitude to the UAE’s leadership for their generosity – not just in providing space for the Mandir, but in welcoming it with open hearts. He extended appreciation to the volunteers for their unwavering dedication and to the donors for their selfless generosity.
 He highlighted the remarkable impact of the Mandir over the past year, sharing that 2.2 million visitors had walked through its doors, 1.3 million free meals had been served, and 1,000 rituals, and 20 weddings, had been performed. He spoke about how these milestones were not just numbers but a reflection of the Mandir’s deeper purpose – bringing people together, nurturing values, and spreading happiness.
 Brahmaviharidas Swami highlighted how the Mandir is the heart of the community, a place that nurtures the soul and strengthens the bonds of society. He spoke about how, even after achieving everything in life, there is something one might still seek – a deeper fulfillment that cannot be bought or measured. The Mandir provides that missing element: inner happiness. By instilling values, fostering selflessness, and inspiring service, it enriches lives in a way that extends far beyond its walls.
 He concluded with a heartfelt reflection: Just as a baby takes its first steps at the age of one, the Mandir has only begun to walk. When we meet next year, it will be two – and it will not only walk, but it will also begin to talk, sharing its message of peace, harmony, and happiness with the world.
 The inspiring program left everyone with a deep sense of pride, happiness, and a renewed purpose.

/News/2025/First-Patotsav-Celebration-at.t: First Patotsav Celebration at BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi, UAE
/News/2025/First-Patotsav-Celebration-at.text:
Photo Gallery 
 First Patotsav Celebration at BAPS Hindu Mandir (44 photos)
 The BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi marked its first patotsav, anniversary of its inauguration, with a series of prayers, celebrations and cultural performances. This momentous occasion drew more than 10,000 devotees and well-wishers from across the region to commemorate a year of spiritual enlightenment and unity.
 From 6:00 a.m., more than 1,100 devotees and well-wishers participated in the sacred mahapuja ceremony in the open passage behind the mandir, offering prayers for universal peace and prosperity. The mahapuja blended technology and spirituality, with special projections on the mandir displaying the various rituals being performed.
 Later, the Nashik Dhol group from Maharashtra welcomed the procession of Bhagwan Swaminarayan from the Maha Abhishek Sthan to the central dome of the mandir, filling the air with rhythmic beats and joyous fervor.
 From 9:00 to 11:30 a.m., in the assembly hall, special verses were recited in honor of the birth anniversary of His Holiness Shastriji Maharaj, the founder of BAPS. The congregation of more than 2,000 people also offered appreciated the vision and generosity of His Highness Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Al Nahyan in fostering a country of love and harmony. 
 In the evening, the Swaminarayan Ghat transformed into a vibrant stage from where mesmerizing music and traditional dance performances rooted in the ancient Natya Shastra were presented. The 19 different performances, with troupes comprising 224 participants, captivated viewers with enthralling renditions of Madhurashtakam, Mohiniyattam, Kuchipudi, Bharatanatyam as well as traditional Marathi, Odissi, and Bengali dances. The presentations were interspersed with artis performed at six, seven and eight o’clock.
 Concluding the celebrations, Brahmavihari Swami commented, "The BAPS Hindu Mandir has witnessed its first year filled will love, hope and unity. It has won awards for its architectural splendor, but its most impressive achievement is that it continues to bring people of all backgrounds together, inspiring an inclusive and harmonious society. May everyone fill their lives with love and unity for all that is around them."

/News/2025/First-Visit-to-Nigeria-by-BAP.t: First Visit to Nigeria by BAPS Swamis, Nigeria
/News/2025/First-Visit-to-Nigeria-by-BAP.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Visit to Nigeria by BAPS Swamis (36 photos)
 Nigeria is a vast country, home to over 250 diverse ethnic groups that speak over 400 languages. It is home to the world's second-largest film industry, and has abundant oil and gas resources. Indians have been settling here since before Nigeria’s independence from British rule in 1960.
 Sindhis, and after the 1990s, Gujaratis have significantly migrated here. For over 50 years, mandirs of Sanatan Hindu Dharma have been constructed and festivals regularly celebrated.
 For years, prominent Sindhi community leaders Shri Anil Gopwani and Shri Lalit Ganwani had been associated with the BAPS organization. These two senior Sindhi members had specifically requested BAPS swamis to bring satsang to Nigeria.
 On 13 March 2025, for the first time, four BAPS swamis – Gunsagardas Swami, Aksharvandandas Swami, Amrutswarupdas Swami and Brahmakirtandas Swami – arrived in Nigeria.
 They were accompanied by several BAPS volunteers. Local devotees managed all the arrangements in Lagos, the capital.
 The swamis met Shri Chandramauli Kumar, India's Consul General in Nigeria. During this meeting, he shared many details about Indians living in Nigeria and swamis discussed the various service activities conducted by BAPS. The swamis presented him a copy of the Satsang Diksha.
 The swamis also visited the ISKCON Mandir, Gita Mandir, Gita Ashram and other Hindu mandirs. The swamis were warmly received, as it was the first time Hindu swamis were visiting.
 On 15 March 2025, in the evening, the swamis conducted a satsang assembly at Sundarkand Pathya. The swamis spoke on the messages of Sundarkand and inspired the devotees to develop steadfast devotion like Hanuman in their lives.
 Additionally, they conducted satsang in small groups at the homes of devotees.
 On 16 March 2025, a public satsang assembly was organized at Gita Ashram, attended by around 200 local followers. The entire arrangement was managed by Sindhi community leader Shri Anilbhai Gopwani. Devotees were delighted by the swamis’ kirtans and discourses. India's Consul General Shri Chandramauli, senior Gujarati community representatives Shri Shaileshbhai Tanna and Shri Chandreshbhai Shah were also present. Quoting the Satsang Diksha, Shri Chandramauli said, “Everything that can be achieved in human life is contained in this Satsang Diksha shastra.”
 The saints visited over 35 devotees' homes, shops, and industrial complexes, offering prayers for their well-being.
 The five-day visit helped to strengthen the devotion of satsangis staying in different places, encouraged others to became satsang-oriented and inspired many to give up vices and adopt a pure lifestyle.

/News/2025/For-the-Sake-of-Akshar-Purush.t: For the Sake of Akshar-Purushottam | Kishore-Kishori Shibir 2025, UK & Europe
/News/2025/For-the-Sake-of-Akshar-Purush.text:
More than 630 kishores and kishoris from across the UK and parts of Europe gathered at Warwick Conference Park for a four-day journey of faith, learning, and inspiration. Themed “For the Sake of Akshar-Purushottam,” this year’s shibir immersed delegates into the life and legacy of Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj, whose sacrifices secured the eternal siddhant of Akshar-Purushottam for generations to come.
 Day 1: For the Sake of Akshar-Purushottam
 The opening session began with a gripping courtroom drama that transported the audience to the era of Shastriji Maharaj. False accusations were vehemently levelled against him for upholding the Akshar-Purushottam siddhant, while delegates served as the jury, experiencing the opposition and hostility he faced.
 Following the drama, Atmatruptdas Swami and Dharmasetudas Swami delivered a session titled ‘Akshar: A Forgotten Chapter,’ drawing on the Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, and other sacred Hindu texts to establish the timeless authority of Akshar-Purushottam Darshan. The afternoon involved interactive group sessions where kishores and kishoris imagined ‘Satsang in 2050.’
 The day concluded with a moving drama that brought to life the inception of BAPS and the creation of Bochasan Mandir, built with unmatched courage and devotion.
 Day 2: Letters, Legacy & Living History
 The second morning began with Yogvivekdas Swami’s narration of ‘the letters that built mandirs,’ in which the handwritten letters of Shastriji Maharaj and Nirgundas Swami revealed their tireless appeals, deep faith, and unshakable determination.
 In the afternoon, Kishori Mandal presented a powerful session titled ‘What Was Her Why?’ A captivating drama unfolded across five acts, brought to life by 50 kishoris, highlighting the seldom-told stories of women whose devotion and sacrifice became the silent foundations of mandirs that propagated the true Akshar-Purushottam siddhant. From Bochasan and Sarangpur to Gondal, Atladara and Gadhada, ordinary women displayed extraordinary courage, humility and resilience in the face of formidable resistance. Their journeys reminded everyone that true strength lies in faith, conviction, and an unwavering “why” that elevates seva and truth above comfort or recognition.
 As evening descended, the stage came alive once more with a dramatic retelling of the immense hardships faced by Shastriji Maharaj and his swamis and devotees, closing on the moving fulfilment of Bhagwan Swaminarayan’s divine wish – the erection of a mandir upon the hill in Gadhada.
 Day 3: A Legacy Continues
 The courtroom reconvened, where the allegations against Shastriji Maharaj were decisively dismantled. Atmatruptdas Swami and Dharmasetudas Swami then spoke on the enduring legacy of our gurus, from Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj, with a heartfelt emphasis on the life and works of Pragat Guruhari Mahant Swami Maharaj. Their words reminded delegates that we are the hands and hearts through which this legacy continues to grow.
 The afternoon sunshine welcomed energetic sports sessions, creating moments of joy while strengthening bonds of teamwork and lifelong friendship.
 A mesmerising kirtan aradhana lit up the night. Led by Gurukirtandas Swami, Gunkirtandas Swami, Paratpardas Swami, and kishores, accompanied by the world-renowned Jaydeepbhai Swadia and his talented ensemble, the hall resounded with devotional music and meaning. The crescendo of kirtans and compères filled every heart with umang (zeal), himmat (courage), and anand (bliss), leaving a glow that lingered long into the night.
 Day 4: Promises for the Future
 The final morning began with a special Q&A session with Yogvivekdas Swami and Dharmasetudas Swami. This was followed by Nirgunpurush Swami’s inspiring presentation on the unbreakable and fulfilled sankalps of the Gurus, reminding all that every divine resolve is ultimately realised through their vision and grace.
 In a moving finale, each delegate penned personal pledges – heartfelt commitments to live for the sake of Akshar-Purushottam.
 The shibir concluded with video blessings from Mahant Swami Maharaj, encouraging daily niyams of tilak-chandlo, satsang reading, and seva.
 Delegates left Warwick not only inspired by the living story of Shastriji Maharaj, but also determined to uphold, imbibe, and share the eternal siddhant he struggled so hard to protect and propound.

/News/2025/Former-Indian-President-Ram-N.t: Former Indian President Ram Nath Kovind Visits BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi, UAE
/News/2025/Former-Indian-President-Ram-N.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Former Indian President Ram Nath Kovind Visits BAPS Hindu Mandir (32 photos)
 The BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi welcomed the former President of India, Shri Ram Nath Kovind, whose presence represented the warmth and dignity of a nation that values unity, honesty, and inclusion.
 Shri Ram Nath Kovind and his family were traditionally received with garlands by the Board of Directors at the Harmony Wall. As the former president walked through the mandir’s serene surroundings, he appreciated the Tolerance Trees, symbolizing unity in diversity, and explored the mandir’s key architectural and spiritual features. He also witnessed The Fairy Tale immersive show, which conveys messages of values, unity, and cultural harmony through engaging visuals and inspiring history.
 Thereafter, Shri Ram Nath Kovind was welcomed by Swami Brahmaviharidas on the mandir plinth and guided under the Harmony Dome. Inside the mandir, Shri Kovindji admired the intricacy of the Pillar of the Pillars, offered heartfelt prayers at each of the seven inner shrines, and reflected on the far-reaching legacy of His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj, whose vision brought this spiritual haven to life.
 Describing the BAPS Hindu Mandir as “a summary of all mandirs”, Shri Ram Nath Kovind lauded its stunning architectural elegance and profound spiritual resonance. He highlighted that the mandir is not only a place of worship but also a living testament to India’s timeless values of acceptance, non-violence, and unity in diversity. Shri Kovindji noted that such a place, built with the spirit of collaboration and devotion, holds the potential to become a global symbol of peace and harmony. He envisioned the mandir as a future gathering place for world leaders where dialogue, mutual respect, and a shared commitment to unity could flourish. He added that this mandir honors and embraces the diverse perspectives and interests of all cultures and countries.
 In a special tribute, he offered heartfelt prayers for the health, prosperity, and visionary leadership of HH Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the President of UAE, expressing deep gratitude for his support in bringing this spiritual masterpiece to life, which now stands as a beacon of hope and togetherness for people around the world.

 Foundation Stone-Laying Ceremony (29 photos)
 More than 950 devotees and dignitaries from across Malawi and abroad gathered for the foundation stone-laying ceremony of the new BAPS Hindu Mandir in Lilongwe, the capital of Malawi, in the presence of Priyavrat Swami and other BAPS swamis; Shri S. Gopalakrishnan, High Commissioner of India to Malawi; Shri Pramodbhai Kalaria, President of Hindu Seva Samaj Malawi; and senior representatives of 11 Indian community organizations from across Malawi.
 Devotees enthusiastically participated to prepare the foundations and decorate the entire premises for this celebration. The foundation stone-laying ceremony included the mahapuja of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, followed by placing of the foundation stones and kumbhs sanctified and blessed by His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj.
 The atmosphere was charged with pride and joy, as devotees offered their heartfelt prayers for the swift and successful completion of this sacred project.

/News/2025/Foundation-Stone-Laying-Cerem.t: Foundation Stone Laying Ceremony of the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Ottawa, ON, Canada
/News/2025/Foundation-Stone-Laying-Cerem.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Mandir Shilanyas Vidhi (20 photos)
 Shilanyas Pujan and Sabha (76 photos)
 In a spirit of devotion, unity, and celebration, the Shilanyas Mahotsav, the Foundation Stone Laying Ceremony for the new BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Ottawa was held with great joy and reverence on Sunday, October 26, 2025. This landmark occasion marked the beginning of a new chapter for the growing Hindu community in the Ottawa region.
 The ceremony featured traditional Vedic rituals and prayers in the presence of BAPS Swamis, invoking peace and well-being for the community, the province, and the entire country.
 His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj visited the City of Ottawa in 1984 and 1988, when he was honoured by the Canadian Parliament. On that day Ottawa witnessed his humility and devotion towards Bhagwan Swaminarayan, making that historic occasion a lasting memory for people around the world. He returned again in 1996. During these memorable visits, he offered heartfelt prayers for the peace, happiness, and progress of the citizens of Ottawa and all Canadians.
 Inspired by his vision and values, BAPS volunteers have since been actively serving the community through a variety of activities — from spiritual assemblies and children and youth development activities to numerous humanitarian efforts led by BAPS Charities, including annual walkathons and food drives in support of local beneficiaries.
 Now, the legacy of His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj continues under the guidance of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, the current spiritual leader of BAPS. Inspired by his vision, land has been acquired for a new Mandir in Ottawa to serve the growing number of devotees and the wider community. Once completed, the Mandir will host activities and events for people of all ages, helping to preserve Hindu traditions and spiritual values. 
 Special guests included:
  - His Excellency Dinesh K. Patnaik, the High Commissioner of India to Canada
  - Karen A. McCrimmon, Member of Provincial Parliament for Kanata–Carleton
  - Councillor Cathy Curry, representing Kanata North Ward 4
  - Councillor David Hill, representing Barrhaven West 
 In his address, the High Commissioner commended BAPS and all volunteers for their tireless efforts in serving the community. He highlighted that the upcoming Mandir will stand as a symbol of peace, service, and unity, reflecting the shared values that connect India and Canada.
 BAPS also extended heartfelt gratitude to members of the Ottawa Police Service, sponsors and well-wishers for their presence and continued support. 
 The Foundation Stone Laying Ceremony marks the first step toward realizing a long-cherished vision — a place of peace, devotion, and community service that will stand as a beacon of spirituality and harmony for all.

/News/2025/GCC-Satsang-Shibir-Prapti-%E2.t: GCC Satsang Shibir: Prapti – Today, Everyday, BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi, UAE
/News/2025/GCC-Satsang-Shibir-Prapti-%E2.text:
Photo Gallery 
 GCC Satsang Shibir: Prapti – Today, Everyday (45 photos)
 Around 1,000 devotees, including 130 children and 77 teenagers, from across the Gulf Region attended the two-day Satsang Shibir at the BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi. Themed ‘Prapti – Today, Everyday’, the shibir provided a practical roadmap to integrate the practice of  ‘Prapti no Vichar – Realization of Attainment’ in their daily lives.
 The shibir as presented in  four sections: ­Attainment, Commitment, Engagement, and Fulfillment.
 Attainment: Realizing Our Greatest Gift
 Anandswarup Swami explained the necessity of understanding the virtues of the Satpurush and recognizing that through him, we have attained Bhagwan Swaminarayan himself.
 Commitment: Taking the Basic Step
 To establish the daily habit of ‘Prapti no Vichar’, three essential ideas were emphasized: Contemplating the glory of the Satpurush, firm belief that we have attained Bhagwan through him, and realizing that nothing else is needed in life.
 Engagement: Learning How to Think About Prapti
 This section emphasized four daily activities to strengthen the daily practice of ‘Prapti no Vichar’:
 Katha: Learning how to actively listen, reflect, and apply the messages of discourses.
 Mansi Puja: Strengthening the inner connection with the Satpurush through meditation.
 Spiritual Reading: Reading and sharing the words of Bhagwan and the Satpurush to reinforce the  realization of one’s prapti.
 Bhajans: Delving into the bhajans on prapti composed by the paramhansas, fostering joy and deeper comprehension.
 During the group discussions, devotees discussed challenges, shared practical solutions, and discovered personalized engagement techniques.
 This section included insightful guidance from Pujya Doctor Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami and Brahmavihari Swami.
  Fulfillment: Experiencing the Joy of Prapti
 The final section provided real-life applications of fulfillment, with explanations from the Satpurush, a Q&A with Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami and Pujya Ghanshyamcharan Swami, a skit illustrating true contentment, and soul-stirring bhajans.
 During the shibir, children, teenagers, and youths attended tailored sessions on the same theme, with teambuilding activities, treasure hunts, scavenger hunts, letter writing, and other engaging activities.
 The shibir provided clarity and determination to the participants, equipping them with the tools, confidence, and devotion to make ‘Prapti no Vichar’ a daily habit.

/News/2025/Governor-General-of-Australia.t: Governor-General of Australia Visits BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir and Community Centre, Canberra, Australia
/News/2025/Governor-General-of-Australia.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Governor-General Visits Canberra Mandir (40 photos)
 Her Excellency, Honorable Sam Mostyn AC, Governor-General of Australia, accompanied by her husband Mr. Simeon Beckett SC, visited the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Canberra.  They were traditionally welcomed with garlands and tying of nadachhadis, as well as a salute by the cadets of Canberra Mandir.
 During a guided tour of the mandir, youth volunteers conveyed to Her Excellency insights into the philosophical significance of the murtis in the central shrine and the Abhishek Mandap, and informed her that the Abhishek Mandap had been funded entirely by Canberra’s youth. Then, she performed abhishek of the murti of Shri Nilkanth Varni.
 In the assembly hall, over 200 people warmly welcomed the Governor-General. The program began with an Acknowledgment of Country, followed by musical performances, a Sanskrit recitation of Satsang Diksha shlokas by children, and heartfelt reflections by youths on the Mandir’s impact in their lives.
 During her speech, Her Excellency shared personal reflections, expressing how deeply the visit had impacted her. She described the Mandir as a transformative experience, stating, "I feel I have a clear head, a whole heart, a pure heart that has been driven by your welcome and the sacrifices and the ways in which you prepare us for the world that is complex and difficult."
 She added, “What strikes me about today is I have heard those words over and over and over. Care, kindness, respect, with the additional words of compassion, love, care for one another.”
 Her Excellency particularly noted the remarkable generosity displayed by the community’s youths, emphasizing their selfless contributions, “I was so moved about the sacrifices of time and resources that brought this Mandir to life. Sacrificing birthday presents – that says so much about giving at a young age.”
 She concluded by expressing heartfelt appreciation: "Your selfless service, your compassionate view of the world, and your love have been deeply felt by us today.”
  Before leaving, Her Excellency warmly engaged with community members, reflecting mutual respect and understanding.

/News/2025/Grand-Acceptance-of-Shri-Swam.t: Grand Acceptance of ‘Shri Swaminarayan Bhashya’ at Mahakumbh 2025, Prayagraj, India
/News/2025/Grand-Acceptance-of-Shri-Swam.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Grand Acceptance of ‘Shri Swaminarayan Bhashya’ (24 photos)
 The Mahakumbh, the largest spiritual congregation of Sanatan Dharma, has long served as a sacred platform where saints, acharyas, scholars, and devotees from across Bharat assemble in a divine confluence of devotion, knowledge, and philosophical dialogue. This revered gathering represents not only ritual sanctity but also an intellectual and spiritual forum where scriptural traditions are discussed, preserved, and strengthened.
 At Mahakumbh 2025, a truly historic milestone unfolded with the widespread and enthusiastic acceptance of the ‘Shri Swaminarayan Bhashya’, a monumental commentary based on the Akshar-Purushottam Darshan revealed by Bhagwan Swaminarayan and inspired by Brahmaswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Authored by Mahamahopadhyay Bhadreshdas Swami, this scholarly work stands firmly within the time-honoured Vedanta shastra tradition. It provides a systematic and lucid exposition of the philosophical teachings of the Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita, and allied schools of Indian philosophy, presenting them with clarity, scriptural authenticity, and faith-supported reasoning.
 During this significant occasion, revered pithadhishwars, mahamandaleshwars, acharyas, and distinguished scholars representing various akhadas, peeths, and spiritual lineages collectively welcomed the ‘Shri Swaminarayan Bhashya’ as an authoritative and meaningful contribution to the Vedantic tradition. Their acknowledgment highlighted the text’s role in enriching philosophical discourse and strengthening the intellectual foundations of Sanatan Dharma.
 With the blessings and encouragement of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, Mahamahopadhyay Bhadreshdas Swami personally met many respected saints and scholars participating in the Mahakumbh. Through thoughtful discussions and respectful exchanges, he presented the philosophical depth and scriptural basis of the ‘Shri Swaminarayan Bhashya’. These personal interactions encouraged deeper understanding and contributed significantly to its growing acceptance among the Sant Samaj and the wider scholarly community.
 Several prominent spiritual leaders conveyed their blessings and appreciation for this scholarly achievement. Among them were Junapeethadhishwar Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Swami Avdheshanand Giri Ji Maharaj and other esteemed saints, including Swami Vishokanand Ji Maharaj, Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Swami Kailashanand Ji Maharaj, Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Swami Balkananand Ji Maharaj, Acharya Mahamandaleshwar Swami Pranab Chaitanya Puri Ji Maharaj, and Swami Govinddev Giri Ji Maharaj. These respected leaders extended their warm felicitations to the author and recognized the Bhashya as an important continuation of the classical commentary tradition that has preserved Hindu philosophical knowledge for centuries.
 The saints and scholars gathered at Mahakumbh 2025 regarded the publication of this scripture as a landmark moment in contemporary Vedantic scholarship. Beyond ceremonial recognition, the occasion became an opportunity for meaningful deliberation on Vedanta, Swaminarayan Darshan, and the timeless principles of Sanatan Dharma. Many members of the scholarly community noted that the text provides an accessible and systematic guide to understanding complex Vedantic teachings, making it valuable for both scholars and sincere spiritual aspirants.
 Recognizing the significance of this contribution, the Sant Samaj emphasized the importance of disseminating the ‘Shri Swaminarayan Bhashya’ widely so that its teachings may benefit seekers across traditions. The acceptance of this work at Mahakumbh 2025 thus represents more than a moment of honour – it marks the addition of a new and meaningful chapter to India’s enduring spiritual heritage, symbolizing a harmonious union of scripture, scholarship, and saintly wisdom.
 ભારતની સનાતન સંસ્કૃતિ અને આધ્યાત્મિક પરંપરાઓનો સૌથી મોટો સંગમ ઉત્સવ એટલે ‘મહાકુંભ.’ માત્ર શ્રદ્ધાળુ-મુમુક્ષુઓ માટે જ નહીં પરંતુ સંતો, મહાપુરુષો અને ધાર્મિક મનીષીઓ માટે પણ ‘કુંભ’ એક દિવ્ય અવસર હોય છે.
 વર્ષ ૨૦૨૫ના ઐતિહાસિક મહાકુંભના પાવન પ્રસંગે, પરબ્રહ્મ ભગવાન શ્રીસ્વામિનારાયણ પ્રબોધિત ‘શ્રીઅક્ષરપુરુષોત્તમ દર્શન’ના સિદ્ધાંતોને અનુલક્ષીને બ્રહ્મસ્વરૂપ પ્રમુખસ્વામી મહારાજની પ્રેરણાથી રચાયેલાં ‘શ્રી સ્વામિનારાયણ ભાષ્ય’નું ભવ્ય સ્વાગત કરવામાં આવ્યું. શાસ્ત્રીય વેદાંત પરંપરા અનુસાર, પ્રસ્થાનત્રયી પર રચાયેલ આ ભાષ્ય ગ્રંથ મહામહોપાધ્યાય સ્વામી ભદ્રેશદાસજીની દિવ્ય લેખનીમાંથી પ્રસ્ફુટિત થયો છે, જે ભારતીય દર્શન, વેદાંત અને ઉપનિષદોના ગૂઢ રહસ્યોને સ્પષ્ટ કરનારો એક મહાન ગ્રંથ છે.
 મહાકુંભના આ મહાસંગમમાં ભારતના સુપ્રસિદ્ધ સંન્યાસ આશ્રમો, પીઠો અને અખાડાઓના પૂજ્ય સંતોએ ‘શ્રી સ્વામિનારાયણ ભાષ્ય’ના આ અદ્વિતીય યોગદાનને સહર્ષ સ્વીકાર્યું અને તેને વેદાંત પરંપરાની એક ઉત્કૃષ્ટ કૃતિ તરીકે બિરદાવ્યું. આ અવસરે વિવિધ અખાડાઓના પ્રમુખ આચાર્યો અને મહામંડલેશ્વરોએ આ ગ્રંથ જોઈ-ચકાસીને સનાતન ધર્મની સમૃદ્ધ પરંપરામાં એક અમૂલ્ય ભેટ સમાન ગણાવ્યો હતો.
 પરમ પૂજ્ય મહંત સ્વામી મહારાજના દિવ્ય આશીર્વાદ અને આજ્ઞાથી, મહામહોપાધ્યાય પૂજ્ય ભદ્રેશદાસ સ્વામીએ મહાકુંભમાં ઉપસ્થિત આદરણીય સંતો, આચાર્યો અને વિદ્વાનો સાથે વ્યક્તિગત મુલાકાત અને શાસ્ત્રીય સંવાદ સાધ્યો હતો. આ હૃદયસ્પર્શી સંવાદો દ્વારા, તેમણે ‘શ્રી સ્વામિનારાયણ ભાષ્ય’નો સાર અને વૈદિકતા રજૂ કર્યાં, જેનાથી સનાતન ભારતના સંત સમાજ અને વિદ્વત્ સમુદાયમાં ભાષ્યોની વ્યાપક સ્વીકૃતિ વધુ મજબૂત બની હતી.
 આ મહાકુંભની દિવ્ય ક્ષણોમાં વિશેષ રૂપે જૂનાપીઠાધીશ્વર આચાર્ય મહામંડલેશ્વર સ્વામી અવધેશાનંદ ગિરીજી મહારાજે ‘શ્રી સ્વામિનારાયણ ભાષ્ય’ને સાદર, સસ્નેહ શુભકામનાઓ પ્રદાન કરી ભાષ્યકાર મહામહોપાધ્યાય સ્વામી ભદ્રેશદાસજીનું હાર્દિક અભિનંદન કર્યું. આ ઉપરાંત, નિર્વાણ પીઠાધીશ્વર સ્વામી વિશોકાનંદજી મહારાજ, નિરંજન પીઠાધીશ્વર આચાર્ય મહામંડલેશ્વર સ્વામી કૈલાશાનંદજી મહારાજ, આનંદ પીઠાધીશ્વર આચાર્ય મહામંડલેશ્વર સ્વામી બાલકાનંદજી મહારાજ, તથા પરમાર્થ સાધક સેવા સંઘના આચાર્ય મહામંડલેશ્વર સ્વામી પ્રણબચૈતન્યપુરીજી મહારાજે પણ આ ગ્રંથની પ્રશંસા કરી અને તેને સંત સમાજ તેમજ સાધકો માટે એક અનમોલ આધ્યાત્મિક માર્ગદર્શક ગણાવ્યો હતો. પરમ શ્રદ્ધેય સ્વામી ગોવિંદદેવ ગિરીજી મહારાજે પણ આ પ્રસંગે ભાષ્ય ગ્રંથોને આધ્યાત્મિક વિરાસત ગણાવી સહર્ષ શુભેચ્છાઓ પાઠવી હતી.
 સાંપ્રત સમયમાં પરમ પૂજ્ય મહંત સ્વામી મહારાજ દ્વારા જીવંત આ અક્ષરપુરુષોત્તમ સિદ્ધાંત માત્ર સ્વામિનારાયણ સંપ્રદાય પૂરતો સીમિત નથી, પરંતુ તે સમગ્ર સનાતન ધર્મના સાધકો માટે પરમ ઉપયોગી છે. આ ગ્રંથ ભારતીય દર્શનની ઉન્નત પરંપરાઓને વૈજ્ઞાનિક અને તર્કસંગત દૃષ્ટિકોણથી રજૂ કરે છે, જે પ્રત્યેક મુમુક્ષુ માટે પથદર્શક સાબિત થશે.
 મહાકુંભ ૨૦૨૫માં પધારેલા સમસ્ત શ્રદ્ધેય સંતો, શ્રી મહંતો અને મહામંડલેશ્વરોએ આ ગ્રંથના પ્રકાશનને એક ઐતિહાસિક ઘટના ગણાવી હર્ષોલ્લાસ સાથે સ્વીકાર કર્યો હતો. આ અવસર માત્ર ગ્રંથના સ્વાગત પૂરતો મર્યાદિત ન રહેતા, વેદાંત, સ્વામિનારાયણ દર્શન અને સનાતન ધર્મના ગૂઢ રહસ્યો પર ગહન વિમર્શનું કેન્દ્ર બન્યો હતો. વિદ્વાન સંતોએ ભારપૂર્વક જણાવ્યું કે વેદાંત અને ઉપનિષદોના ગૂઢ જ્ઞાનને સરળતાથી સમજવા માટે આ એક અત્યંત મહત્વપૂર્ણ ગ્રંથ છે.
 સંત સમાજે આ કાર્યને ભારતીય શાસ્ત્રોની સમૃદ્ધિમાં એક નવો આયામ જોડનારી સિદ્ધિ ગણાવી તેના વ્યાપક પ્રચાર-પ્રસારની આવશ્યકતા પર ભાર મૂક્યો હતો. આ પ્રસંગે ભારતની આધ્યાત્મિક વિરાસતમાં એક સુવર્ણ અધ્યાય ઉમેર્યો છે, જ્યાં શાસ્ત્ર, સંત અને સનાતન સંસ્કૃતિના ભવ્ય સંગમ વચ્ચે આ જ્ઞાનના પ્રકાશપુંજને સમસ્ત સંત સમાજે પોતાના આશીર્વાદથી અભિસિંચિત કર્યો છે.

/News/2025/Grand-Vishwashanti-Mahayagna-.t: Grand Vishwashanti Mahayagna, BAPS Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir, New Delhi, India
/News/2025/Grand-Vishwashanti-Mahayagna-.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Grand Vishwashanti Mahayagna (32 photos)
 Thousands of devotees, seated around 108 yagna kunds (ritual altars), participated with deep devotion and enthusiasm in the Vishwashanti Mahayagna held to celebrate the auspicious festival of Vijaya Dashami.
 The Mahayagna commenced at 6 a.m. and continued until 9 a.m. Swamis invoked divine spiritual energy with the chanting of sacred Vedic mantras to promote global peace and harmony. Many youths also took part in the yagna.
 On this occasion, Munivatsaldas Swami addressed the gathering, “With the divine inspiration and guidance of Mahant Swami Maharaj, this yagna was organized to pray for peace and harmony in the world. Special prayers were offered for every family to remain united, strong, and deeply rooted in spiritual values. Let us draw inspiration from this sacred yagna and embrace family unity and spirituality in our lives.”
 On this sacred occasion, all the participants resolved to establish family harmony and to remove negativity, ego, and hatred from their lives.
 The entire atmosphere of Akshardham was charged with powerful spiritual energy, filling everyone with a profound sense of joy and contentment.

/News/2025/Grand-and-Glorious-Year-in-Re.t: Grand and Glorious: Year in Review, 2025, BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi, UAE
/News/2025/Grand-and-Glorious-Year-in-Re.text:
The year 2025 unfolded as yet another Grand and Glorious chapter in the journey of the BAPS Hindu Mandir Abu Dhabi. This visual tribute features many dignitaries and leaders from across the UAE and around the world who visited the Mandir, affirming its growing role as a beacon of dialogue, respect and coexistence. Their presence reflects the Mandir’s standing as a symbol of shared values and cultural harmony.
 The video also captures the vibrant rhythm of community life, from major festivals and sacred rituals to large-scale gatherings that brought families together in devotion and celebration. In 2025 alone, the Mandir conducted 1,500 rituals, hosted 70 events, and organized 210 prayer assemblies, reflecting both its spiritual depth and its dynamic engagement with the community. It highlights children’s and youth activities that inspired character, creativity and confidence, along with workshops, assemblies and cultural programs that nurtured faith and values in the next generation. Each frame tells the story of a Mandir alive with service, smiles and spiritual energy.
 With sincere gratitude, we thank the generous leadership of the UAE for their continued support in enabling such spiritual and cultural initiatives to flourish. We also offer heartfelt appreciation to every visitor, volunteer and worshipper whose faith and participation give the Mandir its true spirit. In 2025, through its events, activities and collective devotion, the Mandir resonated the message of harmony far and wide.

/News/2025/HH-Mahant-Swami-Maharajs-92nd.t: HH Mahant Swami Maharaj's 92nd Birthday Celebrations, North America
/News/2025/HH-Mahant-Swami-Maharajs-92nd.text:
BAPS devotees across North America came together to celebrate the 92nd birthday of  His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj. The celebrations reflected the theme “Sant Param Hitkari” (A Saint Who Works for the Good of All), highlighting his lifelong dedication to selflessness, compassion, and devotion.
 The program centered on four key virtues embodied by Mahant Swami Maharaj. Sacha Margdarshak illustrated his role as a true spiritual guide, gently leading devotees to Bhagwan with compassion and clarity. Paropkar showcased his selfless love, as he has always placed the happiness and well-being of others before his own. Vicharan honored his tireless travels over decades, made without regard for personal comfort, but solely to inspire and uplift others. Finally, Bhagwan Saday Pragat expressed how, through Mahant Swami Maharaj, countless devotees have experienced the ever-present grace of Bhagwan in their lives.
 Devotees of all ages contributed to the celebration, participating in a grand cultural program in honor of their Guru. Through skits, speeches, musical performances, and traditional dances, participants reflected on these virtues and shared how Mahant Swami Maharaj’s life and guidance continue to inspire faith and unity within their families and communities.
 The celebration created an atmosphere of devotion and gratitude, reminding devotees that the presence of a true saint brings divine connection, joy, and strength to their lives. The celebrations also served as a reaffirmation of the timeless values that Mahant Swami Maharaj embodies, motivating individuals to live with compassion, humility, and service to others.

 || Swami-Shreeji||
 Param Pujya Pramukh Swami
 To All the Followers of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha,
 Jay Swaminarayan from Sadhu Keshavjivandas
 Our prayerful blessings that Bhagwan Swaminarayan may keep you all happy in body, mind and means; that you all may keep peace in your hearts; that unity increases in your family; faith and devotion towards Bhagwan grow; and that the strength to follow the commandments of Satsang is obtained.
 We must especially understand the invaluable attainment we have. Bhagwan Swaminarayan – the manifest Purushottam Parabrahman himself, and Gunatitanand Swami – manifest Aksharbrahman himself, and in that spiritual lineage the Gunatit Gurus all, with deep compassion and grace, have come to this world. What greater attainment can there be? Therefore, remain immersed in the bliss of the Principle of Pragatpanu – that “I have presently attained manifest Akshar-Purushottam.” Like this, one must firm up the conviction of the Principle of Pragatpanu. “Dhanyosmi  purnakamosmi…” – we must chant this again and again.
 Maharaj is supreme and all-doing. This conviction should be kept firm. We want to honor the efforts of Shastriji Maharaj. That is the wish of Yogibapa and Pramukh Swami. I feel the same way – if someone speaks on Akshar-Purushottam, I would keep listening endlessly.
 Now, we too, must commit ourselves to speaking and listening about Akshar-Purushottam, without looking at time and comfort, in the same way that sadhus and haribhaktas like Nirgun Swami, Mahapurush Swami, Maganbhai and Hermanbhai did. Today, on all sides, Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj are being honored. It is proven through the Vedic and Sanatan scriptures. Great scholars from across the world have also verified this. So we should make our conviction firm and with humility share our faith with others. We should please Maharaj with servitude, unity and by following the edicts of Satsang.
 Our prayers and blessings that all of these things become firm in everyone.

 Medical professionals discussed:
 Risk factors for heart disease
 Importance of blood pressure and cholesterol management
 Lifestyle changes to support heart health, including diet and exercise

 Attendees benefited from:
 Health Checks: Blood pressure, BMI, and general wellness assessments
 Information Booths: Resources on nutrition, physical activity, and preventive care
 The seminar fostered a culture of health consciousness and empowered individuals to take charge of their wellbeing. By combining expert knowledge with accessible screening tools, BAPS continues to serve as a beacon of holistic care for the Adelaide community.

/News/2025/Hindu-Mandirs-Participate-in-.t: Hindu Mandirs Participate in Unity Forum, San Jose, CA, USA
/News/2025/Hindu-Mandirs-Participate-in-.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Unity Forum 2025 (18 photos)
 BAPS hosted more than 55 leaders from over 35 faith-based and community organizations across the San Francisco Bay Area at the Unity Forum organized by BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, San Jose, CA, on November 15, 2025, celebrating cultural and spiritual harmony rooted in the Hindu ideal of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam—“the entire world is one family.” The Unity Forum was inspired by His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj’s message: “In the spirit of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam, let’s reach out to extend the circle of global harmony.”
 The program began with a prayer and a focused group discussion where leaders explored key themes related to strengthening the next generation. First, leaders reflected on the qualities of an ideal Dhārmik youth, including confidence in one’s Hindu identity, commitment to personal sadhana, and grounding in authentic Hindu knowledge. Second, they discussed challenges at home and in society, such as widespread misinformation about Hinduism, limited access to authentic explanations of time-tested traditions, and the growing influence of social media and academic narratives that often conflict with Dhārmik values. Third, they reaffirmed a collective commitment to strengthen Dhārmik sanskars in youth by creating relatable engagement, offering mentoring and satsang opportunities, presenting authentic Hindu history in youth-friendly formats, fostering cross-generational connections, and supporting youth with empathy and openness.
 Pujya Chaitanyamurti Swami addressed these themes directly in his keynote remarks. Drawing from his extensive interactions with Hindu and community leaders across North America, he spoke about the central role of sanskars in helping youth develop clarity, confidence, and a strong sense of identity. He highlighted how meaningful mentorship, consistent role modeling at home, and relatable engagement in mandirs can transform these challenges into opportunities for deeper connection and service.
 Pujya Harinivasdas Swami offered a heartfelt vote of thanks and shared life lessons from His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj and His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj on strengthening unity within families, organizations, and the broader community.
 Leaders expressed gratitude for the opportunity to learn, share, and receive guidance from the Pujya Swamis, reaffirming their commitment to building greater unity and supporting the next generation of Hindu youth.

/News/2025/His-Highness-Abdullah-Bin-Zay.t: His Highness Abdullah Bin Zayed Meets Head of BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi, UAE
/News/2025/His-Highness-Abdullah-Bin-Zay.text:
Photo Gallery 
 His Highness Abdullah Bin Zayed Meets Head of BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi (7 photos)
 His Highness Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, extended a warm welcome to Swami Brahmaviharidas, head of the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi, on April 14, 2025. During the meeting, both sides underlined the importance of promoting the universal values of peace, coexistence, and harmony.
 The meeting emphasized that tolerance in the UAE is a value deeply rooted and integrated into the fabric of Emirati society, a home to more than 200 nationalities and a hub for diverse cultures who live in security, safety, and prosperity.
 This discussion reflects the UAE’s commitment to supporting peaceful coexistence and mutual understanding, strengthening bridges of communication and dialogue, and achieving common benefits in a way that contributes to stability and prosperity regionally and internationally. Over the next 50 years, the UAE will continue to further its efforts to maintain its status as one of the leading countries in the world to live and work in, based on its future-focused vision and keenness toward realizing sociocultural diversity.
 While expressing his heartfelt appreciation for His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, UAE President, Swami Brahmaviharidas shared comprehensive plans for the Mandir's development and the upcoming international centers of BAPS in various countries and cities.
 In appreciation of His Highness's continued guidance and inspiration throughout the temple's ideation and creation, Swami Brahmaviharidas presented a special 'Crystal Gift of Gratitude' as a token of inner gratefulness. The BAPS delegation also included Swami Aksharatitdas, Shri Ashok Kotecha and Pranav Desai.
 The BAPS Hindu Mandir has become a symbol of global harmony, reflecting the UAE's commitment to tolerance and coexistence. This constructive meeting underscores the strong bond between the UAE and the Hindu community, highlighting the UAE's dedication to fostering an environment of greater tolerance, peace and understanding.

/News/2025/His-Holiness-Mahant-Swami-Mah.t: His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj Recognized for Achievement in Building Better Communities, USA
/News/2025/His-Holiness-Mahant-Swami-Mah.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Forum on Faith Honors HH Mahant Swami Maharaj (7 photos)
 On Thursday, October 9, 2025, His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj was recognized with the Achievement in Building Better Communities award at the Forum on Faith in New York City. The event, held at the Marriott Marquis Hotel in Manhattan, was organized by more than 30 religious, academic, and governmental organizations, including BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha. It focused on the role that faith organizations play in making the world a better place.
 In honoring His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, the Forum recognized his leadership in mobilizing BAPS volunteers around the world to serve society in meaningful and tangible ways, including in health care, education, and disaster relief. It highlighted his special emphasis on youth development— inspiring young people to become compassionate leaders who will shape the future of their communities— and his championing of women’s leadership and empowerment. The organizers also cited his encouragement of initiatives that promote family harmony, mental well-being, and resilience, equipping individuals with the values and strength to thrive together.
 The Forum on Faith convened approximately 600 participants from diverse sectors, including religious institutions, government, business, academia, the diplomatic corps, and civic organizations. Notable attendees included His Eminence Cardinal Timothy Dolan, Archbishop of New York; Elder Quentin L. Cook of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints; retired Supreme Court Justice Stephen Breyer; and Kathy Hochul, Governor of New York. Central to the event was the theme that faith serves as a constructive influence in society, with the potential to make the world a better place.
 Sneh Amin, a BAPS attendee, remarked, “At the Forum on Faith, we came together not as members of different religions and congregations, but as seekers of understanding and respect. This event was a powerful reminder that unity begins with listening and learning from one another.”

/News/2025/Hon-Speaker-of-Indias-Lok-Sab.t: Hon. Speaker of India’s Lok Sabha Shri Om Prakash Birla Visits Neasden Temple, London, UK
/News/2025/Hon-Speaker-of-Indias-Lok-Sab.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Shri Om Prakash Birla at Neasden Temple (8 photos)
 The Speaker of India’s Lok Sabha, Hon’ble Shri Om Prakash Birla, visited BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in London – popularly known as ‘Neasden Temple’ – on Saturday 11 January 2025 as part of his official visit to the United Kingdom at the invitation of Lindsay Hoyle, Speaker of the House of Commons in the UK.
 Mr Birla was warmly welcomed on behalf of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, the spiritual leader of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS), by swamis of the Mandir in a traditional Hindu manner.
 During his visit, Mr Birla experienced the sanctity of the Mandir with darshan of the murtis and offering abhishek. He was also briefed on the significant work of BAPS in India and the inspiring developments in the UK and across Europe, particularly the upcoming BAPS Swaminarayan Hindu Mandir in Paris, France.
 In February 2022, a senior delegation of Indian parliamentarians, led by Mr Birla, visited the site of the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi. Later that year, Mr Birla met His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi.
 Addressing the evening assembly, Mr Birla remarked, “Coming to this Swaminarayan Mandir [Neasden Temple] inspires one towards spirituality and religion. This Temple not only helps to build spirituality and religion but also humankind. BAPS works for the progress and spiritual upliftment for communities around the world.”
 Paying tribute to the creator of Neasden Temple, His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj, Mr Birla added, “Pramukh Swami Maharaj elevated Indian tradition and culture across the world. He worked for the betterment of humanity across borders. I pay my respects to Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s life message, ‘In the joy of others lies our own.’”
 Sanjay Kara, a trustee for BAPS in the UK, shared, “We are deeply grateful to Mr Birla for taking the time to visit the Mandir as part of his schedule whilst in the UK. It was a delight to exchange meaningful ideas and insights and further strengthen the important ties between India and the United Kingdom.”

/News/2025/Impact-of-Women-Rooted-in-Str.t: Impact of Women: Rooted in Strength, Rising in Purpose, North America
/News/2025/Impact-of-Women-Rooted-in-Str.text:
BAPS centers across North America hosted Impact of Women, a series of events celebrating the contributions and perspectives of women. The gatherings brought together attendees of all ages and backgrounds, including college students, professionals, entrepreneurs, and community leaders. This year’s focus, “Rooted in Strength, Rising in Purpose,” highlighted the strength held in our shared values, which serve as the foundation that enables us to rise in our purpose—our duties, services, and responsibilities.
 Through panel discussions, Q&A sessions, and hands-on demonstrations, attendees engaged in open dialogue about real-life challenges and experiences. Conversations often centered on managing work-life balance in today’s fast-paced world, finding time for self-care, and prioritizing spiritual well-being alongside professional and family responsibilities. Personal stories shared by women from all walks of life offered relatable examples of both struggles and successes, creating a supportive environment where attendees could reflect on their own journeys.
 Beyond the practical takeaways, the events offered space to build genuine friendships, with many attendees sharing that connecting with women at different stages of life and professional paths gave them fresh perspectives and a strong sense of community. The events fostered both inspiration and understanding, allowing participants to walk away with meaningful connections as well as new tools for daily living.
 Across North America, Impact of Women programs underscored how shared experiences, spiritual grounding, and service-minded living can enrich women’s lives. By combining thoughtful discussions with practical activities, Impact of Women highlighted the importance of balance and the strength found in community.

/News/2025/Inauguration-of-BAPS-Hindu-Ma.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Swagat Sabha (27 photos)
 Inauguration Sabha (10 photos)

 Five days of celebrations marked the inauguration of the new BAPS Hindu Mandir and Community Centre in Lower Hutt, Wellington, in the presence of Pujya Narayanmuni Swami, other BAPS swamis and devotees and well-wishers from the ANZ region.
 On 6 August, Narayanmuni Swami and swamis were warmly welcomed. The following day, a satsang assembly was held in the presence of Narayanmuni Swami.
 On the morning of 8 August, a Vedic Shri Swaminarayan Vishwa Shanti Mahayagna was organized for world peace and the well-being of society. Sanctified grains were offered into the ritual yagna flame while children, youth and adult devotees from Australia and New Zealand recited the 315 Sanskrit verses of the Satsang Diksha shastra.
  In the afternoon, over 360 women devotees participated in a special women’s assembly, titled ‘Shashvat Sukh nu dham – ­­­ Mandir’. The cultural program highlighted the importance and benefits of mandirs, and also the inspirational contributions by women devotees that had made this mandir possible. It featured cultural performances and inspiring speeches by young and senior women, as well as video presentations and a Bhakti Tula.
 In the evening, swamis and youths from the ANZ region presented a melodious program of devotional bhajans, gracefully conveying the timeless traditions and enduring values that mandirs instill in individuals and the local community, creating an atmosphere of spiritual harmony and cultural richness.
  On 9 August, the sacred murtis to be installed in the mandir were honored on beautifully decorated floats in a colorful 2km nagar yatra (procession) through the roads leading to the mandir. Devotees from throughout the ANZ region, well-wishers and other esteemed guests participated in this procession.
 In the evening, a special cultural program celebrated the inspirational journey of the BAPS Mandir in Wellington, featuring live interviews and skits of how people's lives are positively impacted by mandirs. 
 On 10 August, the Vedic murti-pratishtha mahapuja and murti-installation rituals were performed by Narayanmuni Swami and swamis in the presence of devotees and well-wishers from across the ANZ region. Thereafter, a dedication assembly was held to celebrate this momentous occasion.
 The event was graced by the presence of Hon. Chris Hipkins, former prime minister and opposition leader; Shrimati Neeta Bhusanji, High Commissioner of India; Mr. Guna Mugesan, President, Hindu Council of New Zealand; Shri Mukesh Giya, Second Secretary and Head of Chancery, High Commission of India; and Dr Carlos Cheung, Member of Parliament. The guests sincerely appreciated and commended the efforts of BAPS and its volunteers, as well as the contribution of the Indian community in the region.
 Previously, in Sarangpur, on  21 May 2024, His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj had performed the Vedic murti-pratishtha rituals of the murtis.

/News/2025/Inauguration-of-BAPS-Shri-Swa.t: Inauguration of BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Ruislip, UK
/News/2025/Inauguration-of-BAPS-Shri-Swa.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Mahapuja (24 photos)
 Nagar Yatra (40 photos)
 Murti Pratishtha in Kanad (8 photos)
 Murti Pratishtha in Ruislip (40 photos)
 Murti Darshan (8 photos)
 Neighbourhood Open Day (8 photos)
 A new chapter of spiritual and community life began in Ruislip, in the London Borough of Hillingdon, with the inauguration of a new BAPS Swaminarayan Hindu mandir on Sunday 31 August 2025.
 The opening was the culmination of months of devoted preparation by hundreds of local volunteers and devotees, whose careful planning and service are now embodied in this beautiful mandir. It will serve not only as a place of worship but also a centre for education, cultural engagement, and charitable work in the Ruislip area and beyond.
 The Ruislip Mandir Mahotsav celebrations began on 2 May 2025, when His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj performed the consecration ceremony (murti pratishtha) in Kanad, Surat, India. On 17 August 2025, a Vedic mahapuja at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London, further prepared hearts and minds for the inauguration.
 Devotees and well-wishers of all ages filled the streets of Rayners Lane and Ruislip Manor with vibrant decorations, devotional music, and joyous celebrations during a grand shobha yatra on Saturday 30 August 2025, during which the sacred images to be installed in the mandir were carried upon decorated palanquins to bless the local area.
 The following morning, with the blessings of Mahant Swami Maharaj, swamis from London performed the murti installation ceremony in the new mandir. Hundreds of devotees and well-wishers gathered in reverence and celebration.
 A number of distinguished guests joined the event, including Cllr Anjana Patel, Mayor of Harrow. She praised the mandir for its contribution to community harmony and service.
 As part of the opening celebrations, the Mandir hosted a Neighbourhood Open Day on 6 September 2025, welcoming local residents and guests, including Cllr Philip Corthorne, Mayor of Hillingdon. Visitors were offered guided tours and presentations, learning more about Hindu culture and the Mandir’s planned spiritual, educational, and charitable programmes. The day reflected the Mandir’s inclusive ethos of service, learning, and fellowship.
 The Ruislip Mandir now stands as a beacon of faith, unity, and selfless service – inspired by the vision and blessings of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj – ready to serve people from all backgrounds and ages for years to come.
 Raj Gajjar, a lead volunteer, shared, “The Mandir Mahotsav has been a joyous occasion, which has truly brought our whole community together. This new mandir is for everyone in Ruislip and beyond. It will be a place where people can find peace, learn, and come together in a spirit of friendship and service.”

/News/2025/Inauguration-of-Medical-Vans-.t: Inauguration of Medical Vans at Swaminarayan Akshardham, Gandhinagar, India
/News/2025/Inauguration-of-Medical-Vans-.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Inauguration of Medical Vans (13 photos)
 BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha’s healthcare services benefit millions each year. Among these, mobile medical clinics provide free diagnosis and treatment, significantly serving underprivileged communities in rural areas.
 Continuing this effort, two new medical vans, donated by Aster Volunteers under the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiative of Aster DM Healthcare, were inaugurated at Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir in Gandhinagar. These vans will be operated by the BAPS Public Charitable Trust.
 Amonmg the dignitaries present at the inauguration ceremony were Gujarat’s Minister of Health Shri Rushikeshbhai Patel, Home Minister Shri Harshbhai Sanghvi, senior BAPS swamis – Nikhilesh Swami, Vishwavihari Swami, Brahmaviharidas Swami, and Puja Aksharvatsaldas Swami – as well as Shri Jalilji and representatives from Aster DM Healthcare.
 These two medical vans will provide essential healthcare services to remote tribal areas of Gujarat. Equipped with modern medical facilities, the vans will serve as mobile clinics offering primary treatment, specialist consultations, and emergency ambulance services. Speaking at the inauguration, Hon’ble Health Minister Shri Rushikeshbhai Patel remarked,
 “By building a mandir in Abu Dhabi, BAPS has fostered cultural and diplomatic ties between India and the Arab nations. Inspired by this, Aster Group of Companies, which operates in the healthcare sector, has donated two medical vans for Gujarat. BAPS already operates 12 mobile medical clinics, and with this addition, the total has increased to 14. These vans will provide vital primary care and emergency medical support in remote tribal areas. I am confident that these new vans will greatly benefit these regions.”
 Representing Aster DM Healthcare, Shri Jalilji also conveyed gratitude to BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha for its remarkable services.
 Brahmavihari Swami addressed the gathering, “With the blessings and guidance of guruhari Mahant Swami Maharaj, BAPS’s healthcare services include 20 hospitals and 12 mobile clinics. Through these initiatives, dedicated BAPS volunteers have provided free medical services to over 6.7 million people through health awareness programs, nutritional supplements, diagnostics, emergency treatments and other initiatives. Today, we are adding another milestone to this journey. Inspired by the construction of the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi, Dr. Azad Moopen, Chairman of the renowned Aster Hospitals Group, has donated two fully equipped medical vans to support healthcare services in Gujarat’s remote villages. Dr. Moopen’s Aster Group operates 34 hospitals across India and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), employing 34,000 staff, including 4,000 doctors. Having witnessed the extensive social services carried out by BAPS in Gujarat, he has generously contributed these two medical vans, which will now serve rural communities. Dr. Moopen has already donated 50 such medical vans across different regions.”
 Following the medical van inauguration ceremony, the ministers and dignitaries offered incense before the divine murti of Tapomurti Shri Nilkanth Varni Maharaj at Swaminarayan Akshardham, seeking blessings for the health and prosperity of the people of Gujarat.

/News/2025/Inauguration-of-New-BAPS-Shri.t: Inauguration of New BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Gold Coast, Australia
/News/2025/Inauguration-of-New-BAPS-Shri.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Womens' Cultural Program (17 photos)
 Cultural Program (21 photos)
 Nagar Yatra (45 photos)
 Kirtan Aradhana (12 photos)
 Mandir Inauguration (53 photos)
 Murtis (6 photos)
 Three days of joyous cultural and spiritual celebrations marked the inauguration of Gold Coast’s first Hindu mandir. In the presence of Pujya Narayanmuni Swami and BAPS swamis, over 3,000 devotees, visitors, and well-wishers from across Queensland and interstate participated in this Murti-Pratishtha Mahotsav. 
 The festivities began on the afternoon of 26 September with a Women’s Cultural Program celebrating spirituality, womanhood, and harmony. Distinguished guests included Meaghan Scanlon MP; Dr Preethi Suraj, President, Federation of Indian Communities of Queensland; and representatives from the Department of Home Affairs and the Multicultural Communities Council Gold Coast (MCCGC).
 The evening assembly featured devotional performances and reflections on community unity and service.
 On 27 September, the murtis to be consecrated in the mandir were honored in a nagar yatra through Broadwater Parklands, Southport. The colorful procession featured beautifully decorated floats and enthusiastic participation from devotees and local residents. The chief guest was Hermann Vorster MP, Assistant Minister for Multicultural Affairs and International Student Attraction. Also present were Renata Jones from the Multicultural Families Organisation (MFO), officers from the Queensland Police Service, and Indian community leaders.
 In the evening assembly, a soul-stirring kirtan aradhana was presented.
 On the morning of 28 September, devotees witnessed the sacred murti-pratishtha rituals and thereafter attended the celebration assembly. Previously, on 26 February 2025 in Melbourne, Mahant Swami Maharaj had performed the Vedic pratishtha rituals of the murtis.
 Premier of Queensland, Hon. David Crisafulli MP, conveyed his wishes through a video message, “The new Hindu temple is a huge milestone, and you should be really proud. To see this journey fulfilled by your community shows the incredible contribution you make to us as Queenslanders.”
 Throughout the weekend, dignitaries and community representatives expressed admiration for the dedication of BAPS volunteers and the spirit of harmony embodied by the event.

/News/2025/Inauguration-of-Renovated-BAP.t: Inauguration of Renovated BAPS Mandir, Loughborough, UK
/News/2025/Inauguration-of-Renovated-BAP.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Seva (20 photos)

 Murti Pratishtha in Loughborough (40 photos)
 Murti Darshan (8 photos)
 History (48 photos)
 The inauguration of the newly renovated BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Loughborough, UK, was celebrated between Friday 8 August and Sunday 10 August 2025.
 With the blessings of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj, who had performed the murti consecration on 2 May 2025 in Kanad, Surat, India, Atmatruptdas Swami, Aksharviharidas Swami and Yogvivekdas Swami ceremonially installed the sacred murtis in the renovated mandir. Several swamis from London also joined the occasion, together with hundreds of devotees and guests from across the country, while many more participated online via a live webcast.
 This long-awaited ceremony marked a new chapter of the continued tireless devotion and selfless service by local devotees and volunteers.
 The weekend of celebrations commenced on Friday with a Vedic mahapuja, in which devotees and well-wishers prayed for peace, harmony, well-being, and prosperity to prevail locally and throughout the world.
 On Saturday morning, a joyous shobha yatra (procession) was held through the streets of Loughborough.
 Speaking on the historic occasion, Vinay Sutaria, lead volunteer at the Mandir, shared, “The Mandir is a second home to many people so it’s great to have had so many volunteers helping to complete the renovations within ten weeks. We can now offer a dedicated space for children, youths, and seniors to engage in various activities.”
 The newly renovated mandir will continue to serve as a place of worship for the local congregation and as a hub for the spiritual, cultural, charitable, and community activities of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha in Loughborough and the wider Charnwood region.

/News/2025/Indian-Spiritual-Leader-Sadhg.t: Indian Spiritual Leader, Sadhguru, Visits BAPS Hindu Mandir, Abu Dhabi, UAE
/News/2025/Indian-Spiritual-Leader-Sadhg.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Indian Spiritual Leader, Sadhguru, Visits BAPS Hindu Mandir (12 photos)
 Indian spiritual leader, Jagadish Vasudev, popularly known as Sadhguru, visited the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi, enhancing the spiritual atmosphere with wisdom and devotion. During his visit, Sadhguru expressed profound admiration for the mandir’s stunning beauty and deep spiritual significance. 
 Sadhguru was warmly welcomed with a garland by Brahmaviharidas Swami at the Harmony Wall. Walking towards the mandir, Sadhguru appreciated the Tolerance Trees from the Czech Republic that depict the significance of preservation and coexistence. He admired the thoughtful confluence of culture and spirituality through the Divine Eye, appreciating the message of harmony emanating from the Harmony Dome. Sadhguru paid his respects at the seven shrines within the mandir and performed the sacred abhishek.  He also appreciated the intricate craftsmanship of the Pillar of the Pillars while reflecting on the power of prayer and the visionary teachings of HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj. 
 Describing the mandir as “a flower and a jewel”, Sadhguru highlighted its universal appeal, encouraging individuals from all walks of life to witness its inspirational presence. His visit was a convergence of spirituality and philosophy, underscoring the mandir’s role as a unifying symbol of culture, faith, and global harmony.

/News/2025/International-Students-Confer.text:
A one-day conference for international students, titled “Ignite the Power Within”, was held at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London, on Sunday 10 August 2025.
 More than a thousand delegates from across the UK attended the conference, which empowered them with guidance on education, career growth and personal well-being while providing a valuable platform for networking and community support.
 The day commenced with light refreshments, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The formal programme began with devotional singing, video presentations, and welcome addresses, and continued with the ceremonial lamp-lighting (deep-pragatya).
 A key highlight of the day was a Q&A session in which students received clarity on critical topics related to education and career opportunities. Delegates described this as highly practical and reassuring. Many also noted that the advice they received would help them give back – by sharing knowledge with peers, mentoring juniors, and engaging in community service alongside their studies.
 The conference was further enriched by the presence of Atmatruptdas Swami and Gnanvatsaldas Swami, who delivered thought-provoking discourses on spirituality, inner strength, and the role of values in achieving success abroad. Their addresses, titled “Importance of Spirituality in the Young Generation” and “Ignite the Power Within”, inspired participants to pursue balance in their academic, professional, and personal lives.
 They also offered guidance on how students could integrate education with higher values, helping them to become not only successful professionals but also responsible citizens and role models.
 In addition to these talks, the day featured interactive sessions that blended practical advice with cultural and spiritual nourishment. The event concluded with a networking dinner, where delegates and speakers engaged in meaningful conversations and forged new friendships.
 Reflecting on her experience, one delegate shared, “This conference gave a renewed sense of purpose and belonging. Listening to the swamis reminded me of the importance of inner strength alongside career goals.”
 Harsh Patel, one of the volunteers who helped organise the event, added, “The conference was about more than just personal growth. It provided guidance and encouragement to excel academically and professionally, as well as contribute positively to the communities they live in, making education a means of service as well as success.”

/News/2025/International-Womens-Day-Cele.t: International Women's Day Celebration by BAPS Women's Wing 2025, India
/News/2025/International-Womens-Day-Cele.text:
During March, based on this year’s United Nations theme for International Women's Day, ‘Accelerate Action’, the BAPS Women's Central Office organized programs at BAPS centers in towns and cities throughout India titled, ‘Path of Progress – Attainment’.
 Young and senior women presented inspiring speeches, thematic dances, and yoga performances, and participated in discussions on a variety of spiritual and cultural topics.
 During the assemblies, girls who had memorized all the Sanskrit verses from ‘Satsang Diksha’ and ‘Siddhant Karika’ were honored along with their mothers.
 Many dignitaries also attended the special Women's Day assemblies organized across India. The dignitaries praised the diverse social services conducted by the BAPS and expressed their reverence towards Brahmaswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj and present Guru Mahant Swami Maharaj.
 At the end of the International Women's Day assemblies, prayers were offered for the girls memorizing the Satsang Diksha text under the ‘Mission Rajipo’ project to earn the blessings of Mahant Swami Maharaj.
 Similar celebrations were held by the Women’s Wing at BAPS centers in North America, the UK, Africa and the Asia Pacific.

/News/2025/Island-of-Heroes-Childrens-Cu.t: Island of Heroes: Children’s Cultural Adventureland, Dublin, Ireland
/News/2025/Island-of-Heroes-Childrens-Cu.text:
Photo Gallery 
 Island of Heroes, Dublin, Ireland (36 photos)
 More than 500 children and family members were inspired by the ‘Island of Heroes: Children’s Cultural Adventureland’ at Hansfield Educate Together National School in Dublin 15, Ireland, on Sunday 29 June 2025.
 Organised by BAPS Ireland’s Bal-Balika Mandal and Kishore-Kishori Mandal, the event marked a landmark initiative to bring together the local community for a day of joyful learning and values-based inspiration, entirely free of charge.
 The ‘Island of Heroes’ was an immersive and interactive experience designed to engage children and families through a vibrant blend of storytelling, educational activities, games, and cultural performances. The ‘Island of Heroes’ had several attractions, including the ‘Mountain of Shravan’ shadow play, a 3D experience on climate change, a Ramayan-based production called the ‘Sea of Squirrels’, an escape room challenge, and a live magic show. Each activity was carefully curated to not only entertain, but also instil timeless values such as hard work, selfless service, environmental care, mutual respect, and community harmony.
 Alongside the main attractions, families enjoyed indoor and outdoor fun activities, including bouncy castles, face painting, henna art, mascots, indoor games, and delicious food stalls. These vibrant elements created a festival-like atmosphere that kept children engaged and smiling throughout the day.
 The planning and execution of the event were led by a core team of eight youth volunteers, supported by 61 dedicated helpers, many of them children and teenagers themselves. Their energy, commitment, and sense of seva ensured smooth check-ins, engaging content, and a safe, welcoming environment for all attendees.
 The event left a lasting impact on the community. Many parents expressed appreciation for the inspiring messages, the professionalism of the young organisers, and the opportunity for their children to learn through fun and culturally enriching activities.
 The ‘Island of Heroes’ in Dublin beautifully presented the spirit of teamwork, seva, and cultural celebration. With support from Fingal County Council and the Fingal Integration Office, the event was a testament to what young volunteers and a united community can achieve.
 As the event concluded, families left uplifted, inspired, and connected – ready to nurture the values they had experienced and to carry forward the legacy of heroism in their own lives.
